jobs.title: Director of Innovation Management & Strategy
jobs.description:
In short
Join On’s Footwear Innovation team as the Director of Innovation Management, where you will lead a dynamic group of technology-affine business developers and technical project managers. Your mission will be to amplify the impact of product innovation by strategically managing the innovation portfolio, process, and long-term vision. This role focuses on leading the Innovation Management team, driving active visioning and strategy creation, and ensuring that our innovation initiatives—from "Big Bets" to our iconic technology franchises—are translated into impactful realities for On.

We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Director of Innovation Management to lead a critical function within our Innovation department. This role is pivotal in ensuring our innovation efforts are strategically focused, efficiently executed, and prioritized across the organization. You will lead a team of talented professionals to maximize the impact of innovation at On, utilizing a strong foundational understanding of technology and material science to guide the strategic direction of our portfolio and technology brand franchises.

Your Mission

Strategic Leadership:
- Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for Innovation Management, including active visioning and strategy creation, aligning with On's overarching business objectives.
- Lead and mentor the Innovation Management team, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
- Drive a culture of continuous improvement in innovation processes and strategic portfolio alignment.
- Act as the primary link between Innovation and the rest of the company to ensure strategic cohesion.

Innovation Management Leadership:
- Ensure Innovation initiatives are strategically aligned with On's overall goals and priorities.
- Oversee the management of the Innovation Portfolio, including prioritization, resource allocation, and progress tracking.
- Serve as the PMO for "Big Bet" Innovation projects, ensuring high-impact initiatives are executed with excellence.
- Lead the continuous improvement and operational excellence of the end-to-end innovation process.
- Develop and implement frameworks and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of innovation activities.

Strategic Technology Alignment:
- Manage specific tech brand franchises and oversee the technology roll-out for key innovations such as Superfoam, CloudTec®, and New Propulsion Tech.
- Ensure the successful identification and evaluation of new technologies and materials that provide a competitive advantage.
- Oversee the strategic technology roadmap, ensuring workstreams are prioritized based on strategic alignment and potential impact.
- Collaborate with all technical teams to ensure a smooth horizontal transition of innovations into the product organization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
- Work closely with all teams in the product organization to ensure alignment and effective collaboration on innovation initiatives.
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels regarding the innovation portfolio, processes, and technology roadmap.
- Manage budgets and resources effectively, ensuring optimal utilization.

Your story
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field.
- Proven track record of leadership for +10 years in an innovation management or product strategy function, preferably within the sportswear or a similar consumer-facing industry.
- Strong foundational understanding of technologies and material science to effectively evaluate innovation potential and manage tech franchises.
- Deep understanding of innovation processes, portfolio management, and operational excellence principles.
- Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams and drive strategic visioning.
- Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
- A strong interest in sports, technology, sustainability, and innovation.

About the Team
The Innovation team is responsible for On’s future products, out-of-the-box thinking and athlete-informed technology that differentiates On’s products in the market to become the most premium global sportswear brand, built on performance, design and impact. Within the Innovation team, you will lead two highly motivated and skilled teams: Innovation Management and Technology Management. The Innovation Management team focuses on the strategic alignment of innovation initiatives, the effective management of our innovation portfolio, and the continuous improvement of our innovation processes. The Technology Management team is responsible for the successful scaling, implementation, and continuous evolution of our key technologies, ensuring that strategic technology initiatives are driven forward effectively. Together, these teams are crucial in translating bold ideas into impactful realities for On.

Vi søker en dyktig og engasjert styrer til Sinsen barnehage i Bydel Grünerløkka.

Styrer har en viktig rolle i å utvikle ansatte og kvalitetssikre det faglige arbeidet i barnehagen, og i Sinsen barnehage skal vi nå øke fra 1 til 2 styrere.
Som styrer vil du også være en del av et lederteam med andre styrere i bydelen.

Når vi nå skal ha 2 styrere i samme barnehage søker vi etter ledere med ønske om å skape en best mulig helhet der en kan spille på hverandres styrker og kompetanse.

Bydelens kommunale barnehager er varierende i størrelse, fra 2 til 17 avdelinger.

Sinsen barnehage er en avdelingsbarnehage med totalt 10 avdelinger samlet i fem bygg på samme område.

 

I vår bydel har vi delt barnehagene i to områder hvor hvert område ledes av en seksjonssjef.

Du vil få god støtte fra konsulenter til enkelte administrative oppgavene som ligger i stillingen. Bydelen har stort fokus på kompetanseheving for ledere og vi har jevnlige styremøter hvor vi har fokus på erfaringsdeling og økt samhandling.

Barnehagene i bydel Grünerløkka er pedagogiske knutepunkt med hovedfokus på språk og folkehelse. Vi samarbeider med foresatte for at alle barn skal oppleve en trygg, meningsfull og utviklende hverdag.
Oslo kommune vektlegger tillitsbasert styring og ledelse som grunnverdi og foretrukket ledelsesmetode, og forventer dette hos nye ledere.

Barnehagen er preget av et stabilt personale med mye kompetanse, ønske om å være faglig oppdatert og som ser på endringer som muligheter.

Barnehagen ligger i grønne omgivelser, nært til Sinsenkrysset og kollektivtrafikk.


ArbeidsoppgaverLede og videreutvikle barnehagen pedagogisk, personalmessig og administrativt, samt bidra til god
kvalitetsutvikling av bydelens samlede barnehagetilbud.
Følge opp det pedagogiske arbeidet med planlegging, dokumentasjon og vurdering av barnehagens
innhold og arbeidsmåter
Sørge for at alle ansatte deltar i veiledning og kompetanseutvikling, og at alle ansatte medvirker i faglig
utviklingsarbeid.
Forvalte personal- og budsjett ressurser i henhold til gitte fullmakter
Sikre at internkontroll, HMS-arbeid og bruk av kvalitetssystemer er i tråd med overordnede føringer og
mål
Sikre at det utvikles gode informasjons- og tverrfaglige samhandlingsrutiner både internt, og eksternt
Sørge for godt samarbeid med foreldrene og andre aktuelle instanserKvalifikasjoner
  • Du er utdannet førskolelærer/barnehagelærer eller har annen relevant universitets- eller
    høgskoleutdanning som gir barnefaglig og pedagogisk kompetanse
    Du har relevant ledererfaring, helst som barnehagestyrer og er dyktig på å lede og motivere andre
    Du har god barnehagefaglig kunnskap, og kan vise til resultater i arbeid med å lede utviklings- og
    endringsarbeid i barnehagen
    Det er ønskelig med gjennomført styrerutdanning
    Du har god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne, jf. Lov om barnehager § 28
    Du har økonomiforståelse
    Gyldig politiattest må foreligge før tiltredelse, jf. Politiregisterloven §39 første ledd.
Personlige egenskaper

Du har mot til å lede

Du er positiv, engasjert og vektlegger et godt samarbeid der alle bidrar

Du er strukturert og ansvarlig

Du har evne til å bygge gode relasjoner og skape tillit

Du har evne til å engasjere og motivere medarbeidere

Du er faglig oppdatert, og ønsker å dele kunnskap og refl ektere sammen med andre

Du har evne til å skape stabilitet og forutsigbarhet

Du er opptatt av hva innbyggerne har behov for og er endringsvillig

Vi tilbyr
  • Alle våre barnehager ligger sentralt og i umiddelbar nærhet til kollektivtrafikk
    En unik mulighet til å være med å videreutvikle et sterkt fagmiljø
    Være en del av en ledergruppe med høy faglig kompetanse
    Plass i bydelens lederutviklingsprogram
    Oslo kommune har samarbeidsavtale med BI og OsloMet om Lederutdanning for styrere
    Veiledning etter behov og ønske
    5 planleggingsdager
    Meget gode og gunstige forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger
    Lønnstrinn 51, 825 100 kr per år
KontaktinformasjonEndre Håkonsen, Seksjonssjef barnehage, 21802180

0585 Oslo

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bydel Grünerløkka er en sentrumsbydel med et rikt kulturliv og sosialt mangfold. 

Bydelen er den største blant Oslos bydeler etter befolkningstall, med 64.000 innbyggere. Vi har store og solide fagmiljøer og tilbyr ulike tjenester rundt de viktigste rammene av innbyggernes liv. Bydel Grünerløkka legger vekt på brukermedvirkning og samhandling med innbyggere og andre offentlige og private aktører.

Vi ønsker ansatte som er ambisiøse på egne og samfunnets vegne. Våre ledere er opptatt av å legge til rette for gode utviklingsmuligheter.

Som ansatt i Bydel Grünerløkka vil du oppleve en inkluderende kultur med stor takhøyde og mye engasjement for hverandre og de vi jobber for.

Våre ledere og ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

jobs.title: Sales support en customer service medewerker
jobs.description:
Ontdek een boeiende rol als Sales Support en Customer Service Medewerker in Ieper. Bouw duurzame klantrelaties op, verwerk bestellingen en optimaliseer bedrijfsprocessen. Profiteer van groeikansen en een aantrekkelijk salaris. Solliciteer vandaag voor deze dynamische functie!

De functie inhoud
Als medewerker Sales Support en Customer Service maak je deel uit van een zeskoppig team. Volgende zaken behoren tot je takenpakket:
  • Als aanspreekpunt voor de klanten bouw je een duurzaam klantencontact op. Op die manier komen vragen met betrekking tot bestellingen bij jou terecht.
  • Je ontvangt bestellingen en verwerkt deze in het systeem.
  • Op een klantvriendelijke manier voltooi je verkopen, waarbij je de klant voorziet van correcte informatie over prijzen, levertijden, enz.
  • Binnenkomende klachten zal jij behandelen en bespreken met het het team of de juiste persoon.
  • In tandem met externe vertegenwoordigers zorg je voor ondersteuning vanuit de site in Ieper.

Onze klant
Dit bedrijf in Ieper is lid van een internationale groep. Ze specialiseren zich in het verzorgen van de hygiëne en veiligheid voor de landbouwsector en voedingsindustrie. Wie ben jij als Sales Support en customer service medewerker in Ieper?
  • Bij voorkeur heb je een bachelor diploma of aantoonbare relevante ervaring.
  • Je bent een teamspeler, maar waardeert ook de nodige autonomie in je werk.
  • Communicatief vaardig bouw je snel vertrouwensrelaties op.
  • Je bent int staat om proactief te handelen en weet iedereen te overtuigen met jouw commerciële flair.
  • In dit bedrijf is Engels de voertaal en zal jij je vooral toespitsen op de Franse markt een goede kennis van Frans en Engels is dan ook een must!
  • Heb je ervaring met SAP? Dat is een troef!

jobs.title: Responsable adjoint parc de loisirs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Profil recherché :

- Ancien directeur de centre de loisirs
- Responsable d'équipement de loisirs ou de camping
- Membre du bureau d'une association sportive ou agent de développement de club sportif
- Diplômé en management du sport et des loisirs
- Formateur aux métiers du sport et de l'animation

Compétences et expérience :

- Encadrement et accueil de tout public (enfants, parents, partenaires)
- Gestion de projet, service client et gestion des conflits
- Notions de commerce, marketing et communication
- Management et formation d'équipe
- Gestion, entretien d'un équipement et sécurité/réglementation ERP
- Maîtrise des outils de caisse et informatique de base
- Gestion de stock et tenue d'un snack (normes HACCP indispensables)
- Premiers secours (PSC1 ou SST requis)
- Bricolage léger (maintenance de premier niveau : structures gonflables, karts)
- Animation et événementiel

Qualités recherchées (Soft Skills) :

- Esprit "Comique" : Souriant, énergique, dynamique, créatif et convivial.
- Esprit "Protecteur" : Responsable, rigoureux sur la sécurité, avenant et empathique.
- Autonomie & Polyvalence : Investi et débrouillard, capable d'anticiper les tâches et d'alterner rapidement entre la caisse, la préparation au snack et l'entretien du site.

Missions et champs d'action :
En tant que véritable bras droit du gérant, l'objectif est d'assurer la sécurité et la satisfaction des familles.

Pendant la saison (Gestion opérationnelle du parc et du snack) :
- Ouverture et fermeture sécurisée du site (mise en place et vérification des équipements).
- Surveillance des structures (notamment le nouvel accro-filet).
- Accueil physique/téléphonique, billetterie et encaissement.
- Préparation et service au snack lors des heures d'affluence.
- Coordination de 1 à 2 saisonniers en l'absence du gérant.

Hors saison (Collaboration sur le développement) :
- Stratégie marketing, communication, commercialisation et prospection.
- Événementiel, gestion RH et maintenance des locaux.
- Optimisation de la relation client et des outils de gestion.
- Gestion globale du snack (offres, achats, tarification).

Conditions de travail :

- Contrat : CDD de 12 mois à temps plein (septembre à août), avec temps de travail annualisé/modulé.
- Rémunération : Classification CCN ELAC. Au démarrage : Niveau III - Échelon 2 - Coefficient 215 (Assistant Confirmé).
- Évolution : Passage possible au Niveau IV - Agent de Maîtrise (Coefficient 250) après confirmation d'une autonomie totale.

jobs.title: Kosmetologi
jobs.description:
**Etsitkö mukavaa paikkaa palvella asiakkaitasi?**

**Meillä olisi juuri sinulle sopiva työtila!**

**Ehkäpä etsimme juurikin toisiamme!**

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme parturi-kampaajia extraamaan viikonloppuisin ja pyhinä!

HILE on toiminut Tampereella jo vuodesta 2012. Toimintamme on jo vakiintunut ja olemme luotettava toimija alalla. Erinomainen palvelu, laatu ja työilmapiiri ovat meille äärettömän tärkeitä.

Tarjoamme käyttöösi viihtyisän, siistin, kauniin ja valmiin työtilan. Tämä on loistava mahdollisuus sinulle, joka haluat palvella asiakkaitasi toinen toistaan tukevassa tiimissä.

Vaikka olemme iso työyhteisö, meillä kaikkien on oikeasti todella hyvä olla. Töihin on aina kiva tulla ja kaikki puhaltaa yhteen hiileen ja kaikki tsemppaa aina kaikkia. Meillä kaikki, niin yrittäjät kuin opiskelijatkin ovat aina viihtyneet lopulta pitempään, mitä suunnitelma on alunperin ollut <3 tämä kertoo hyvästä ja lämpimästä työyhteisöstä.

Voit olla parturi-kampaaja, kosmetologi tai muu kauneusalan ammattilainen!

Sopimus voi olla kiinteä päivävuokra tai provisiomalli! Jutellaan tästä yhdessä!

Meillä saat:

\- valmiit ja tyylikkäät tilat

\- joustavan mahdollisuuden ja startin yrittäjyyteen

\- apua markkinointiisi

\- ammattimaisen ja viihtyisän työympäristön

\- mahdollisuuden tehdä töitä omilla ehdoillasi

\- tiimin tuen <3

Kiinnostuitko?

Täytä hakemus: https://hiletampere.fi/hakulomake <3

jobs.title: CUSTOMER SERVICE medewerker
jobs.description:
We zijn op zoek naar een energieke en gedreven Customer Service medewerker om ons interne sales team in Ternat, België, te versterken.

Zorg dat het proces van offerte tot bestelling zo soepel mogelijk verloopt om onze klanten supertevreden te houden.
Geef de juiste technische info door zodat de bestelling efficiënt en correct geplaatst kan worden.
Als Customer Service medewerker ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt en interne ambassadeur voor onze klanten.

 

  • Voorbereiding van offertes in overleg met de klant (alle technische en commerciële gegevens opvragen en de voorgestelde oplossing uitleggen) en deze naar de juiste technische afdeling sturen.
  • Contact onderhouden met klanten en het verkoopteam.
  • Op basis van een plan de juiste technische informatie verzamelen en invoeren in de configurator.
  • Technische tekeningen maken indien vereist door het product.
  • Gegevens controleren.
  • Offertes opstellen.
  • In overleg met verkoop de marge op geplaatste orders realiseren.
  • Fouten in het systeem, voorraadbreuken en ontbrekende informatie identificeren.
  • Samenwerken met andere afdelingen om de klanttevredenheid te verhogen.

 

 

 

 

Om succesvol te zijn in deze rol heb je nodig:

  •  Je beschikt minimum over een een bachelor of je hebt gelijkwaardige werkervaring
  • Je hebt werkervaring in de bouwsector; eerdere ervaring in Customer Service of After Sales is een pluspunt.
  • Theoretische basis van tekenprogramma's zoals CAD of Inventor, werkervaring met deze programma's is een pluspunt.
  • Je bent gedreven, klantgericht en commercieel ingesteld.
  • Je bent oplossingsgericht en een teamspeler, een centraal aanspreekpunt dat moeilijke situaties kan beheren en oplossingen kan bieden om deze succesvol af te ronden.
  • Ervaring met ERP-systemen (Navision; AX; Dynamics D365; SAP;...) is een pluspunt.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van Microsoft Office en begrijpt de werking van CRM-software.
  • Naast Nederlands heb je een goede kennis van Frans en basiskennis van Engels.
  • Dit is een spannende rol bij een gerenommeerde marktleider die een breed scala aan producten biedt in een dynamische sector die gedreven wordt door innovaties op het gebied van duurzame bouwoplossingen.

jobs.title: Principal Recruiter – FMCG & FoodTech
jobs.description:
Assignment

I am seeking a recruiter to represent me in identifying and securing my next full-time career opportunity. The assignment involves identifying relevant companies and positions, engaging hiring managers and decision-makers, presenting my profile, and supporting the recruitment process through to successful placement.

Responsibilities

    Use existing networks and market knowledge to reach hiring managers, and decision-makers
    Identify suitable career opportunities within product, innovation, strategy, and commercial functions
    Provide market insight regarding companies, roles, and career positioning
    Support communication and relationship-building throughout the recruitment process

Background

Experience recruiting across Europe for commercially oriented roles within Food & Beverage, FMCG, Food Retail, and FoodTech is highly desirable. The ideal partner has a proven track record of recruiting for the following functions:

    Product Manager / Product Strategy
    Innovation Manager
    Brand Manager / Category Manager
    Commercial Strategy
    Business Development
    Strategy / Strategic Planning
    Consumer Insights
    Portfolio Management

Compensation

This is a flexible, success-based assignment. Compensation will be provided through a finder’s fee upon successful placement into a suitable role.

Application

Please provide a short overview of your recruitment background, relevant industry experience, and examples of companies or professional networks you can access.

jobs.title: kirkemusiker/organist søges
jobs.description:
Det nye Sydlollands pastorat søger

Kirkemusiker / Organist

Søges til Rødbyhavn, Fuglse  og Errindlev menighedsråd i det nye Sydlolland Pastoret, der omfatter kirkerne Rødbyhavn, Fuglse, Krønge, Torslunde, Errindlev, Tågerup og Olstrup

 

Kan du spille orgel som fantomet i Phantom of the Opera? Eller kan du klimre klaver, så det klinger sødt i sky til Juletid? Vil du være med til at gøre kirkerne til en endnu hyggeligere arbejdsplads, end de er i forvejen.

 

Stillingen, der er ledig fra den 1. oktober 2026, er en deltidsstilling, der søges besat pr. den 1. oktober 2026, eller efter aftale.

 

Stillingen er på 29 timer pr. uge og aflønnes i henhold til Kirkeministeriets takster for faglærte eller ufaglærte Organister og vil være omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Statstjenestemændenes Centralorganisation af 2010 (CO10 fællesoverenskomsten) og

organisationsaftale for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som henholdsvis kordegn, sognemedhjælper eller kirkemusiker og det tilhørende protokollat for kirkemusikere.

Ansættelse af en uddannet organist vil være omfattet af Overenskomst mellem Kirkeministeriet, CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 og Dansk Organist og Kantor Samfund (DOKS) for organister.

Årslønnen indeholder et rådighedstillæg der tillægges den løn, der modsvarer organistens uddannelse niveau.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte organister har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Løn samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk

 

Du skal bl.a. spille ved de ugentlige højmesser, 2 -3 gange pr. søndag, Gudstjenester og Andagter på årets Hellig- og Mærkedage, lige fra Jul til 1. maj. Til Konfirmation, Dåb, Vielse og Begravelse. Til særlige tjenester som f.eks. Spaghetti Gudstjeneste, Juletræs tænding og besøg i Børnehave og Dagpleje. Der kan også være Sangeftermiddag, samt til en eller to koncerter.

 

Pastoratet omfatter 9 kirker fordelt på 4 selvstændige menighedsråd, hvoraf det ene  menighedsråd har deres egen organist.

 

Orglet i Rødbyhavn Kirke er et Bruno – Christensen orgel fra 1966 med 12 stemmer, 2 manualer

Orglet i Fuglse Kirke er et Bruno - Christensen orgel fra 2001 med 13 stemmer.

Orglet i Krønge Kirke er et J. Gregersen orgel fra 1851 med 5 stemmer.

Orglet i Torslunde Kirke er et Krohn orgel fra 1973 med 4 stemmer med anhangspedal.

Orglet i Errindlev Kirke er et Fabricius og søn orgel

Orglet i Torslunde kirke er et Markuson orgel

Orglet i Olstrup kirke er et nyt elorgel

 

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til personaleansvarlig Janne Helmer Jensen, Rødbyhavn, telf. 41 66 70 05/ Lea Hammerich, Fuglse, tlf: 24 27 25 54/ Marianne Hansen, Errindlev, telf: 41 42 80 94

Ansættelsen vil af tekniske årsager ske hos Fuglse, Krønge og Torslunde Menighedsråd, hvortil ansøgningen også skal stiles. Ansøgningen med relevante bilag sendes pr. mail til FKT Menighesråd ved formand Ane Høgh, på mail, 7657fortrolig@sogn.dk. Referencer kan forventes afprøvet.

 

Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde senest den 25. august 2026 for at komme i betragtning. Alle ansøger vil få skriftligt svar på mail.

 

Ansættelsessamtaler og prøvespil vil finde sted sidst i august 2026 i Rødbyhan Kirke.

jobs.title: Onderhoudsmonteur Subtropisch Zwemparadijs (30u/wk)
jobs.description:
De Onderhoudsmonteur Subtropisch Zwemparadijs is onder andere mede verantwoordelijk voor het goed en probleemloos functioneren van alle installaties en faciliteiten.

Takenpakket (o.a.):

  • plannen en uitvoeren van (preventief) onderhoud;
  • opvolging waterkwaliteit en maatregelen om deze kwaliteit stabiel te houden;
  • onderhoudswerken en reparaties in het zwembad, de kelderruimte (pompen, compressoren, electriciteit, water...) en de omkleedruimtes;
  • diverse controles/rapportages ivm veiligheid,
  • vooraadbeheer,
  • je werkt met electriciteit, pneumatische en hydraulische installaties en chemiecaliën.
  • Gezien de urgentie van sommige interventies woon je op maximaal 30 minuten van Houthalen-Helchteren.
  • je bent je ervan bewust, dat interventies ook 's avonds of s' nachts kunnen voorkomen.
  • Je wordt eveneens opgeleid en ingedeeld in de Technische Dienst van het Vakantiepark. Hier hoort ook een permanentiedienst bij (in beurtrol), waarbij je telefonisch bereikbaar bent en voor dringende zaken moet uitrukken. (Voor deze diensten kan je eventueel in een verblijfsaccommodatie op het Vakantiepark verblijven.)

Een zeer afwisselende functie waarin je zowel strikte procedures opvolgt maar ook creatief uit de hoek dient te komen. We voorzien een grondige en gedegen inwerkperiode, onder andere met externe partners.

Het zwembad is tijdens schoolvakanties alle dagen open en werk je 6/7. De extra uren die je hierbij maakt, kan je tijdens het laagseizoen en de winter recupereren. Buiten de vakantieperiodes is het zwembad open op woensdagnamiddag en op zaterdag en zondag.

Het Vakantiepark is geopend voor gasten van Pasen tot midden November. Tijdens de Belgische en Nederlandse schoolvakanties kan je zelf geen vakantie nemen. De overige maanden doen we vooral algemene onderhoudswerken, nemen eventuele overuren terug en werken we van maandag tot vrijdagmiddag.

Technisch inzicht, logisch en gestructureerd denken, hands on mentaliteit en vooral: interesse om op diverse vakgebieden die horen bij het werken in een zwembad, kennis te vergaren.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker
jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring in een administratieve functie met logistieke touch? Ben je communicatief sterk en geeft klantencontact jou heel wat energie? Kom snel meer te weten over deze functie als Customer Service Medewerker regio Wetteren en geniet binnenkort van een aantrekkelijk brutosalaris tussen €2500-€3400.

De functie inhoud
Wat houdt de job van een Customer Service Medewerker in?

jobs.title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity.

Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.

Job Description
You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry.
As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

  • Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
  • Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
  • Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
  • Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends

Profile

  • MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.


Employment Conditions

  • Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390

Important Notice
Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply.
Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

jobs.title: Arbeider coating waterdichtingswerken
jobs.description:
We zijn een sterk groeiend en dynamisch bedrijf met 18 collega's en marktleider in waterdichting- en luchtdichtingswerken bij nieuwbouw en renovatieprojecten.

Uw hoofdtaak is het aanbrengen van solventvrije coatings, door middel van airless spuit-/rol- of kwasttechnieken. Deze coatings worden aangewend voor de waterdichting en luchtdichting van gebouwen, vb. van funderingen, kelderwanden, etc.

Deze technieken worden u aangeleerd; ervaring in verftechnieken is geen vereiste. U werkt steeds samen met een ervaren collega.

Ervaring in de bouwsector is een pluspunt.

Onze troeven voor jou: hoge verloning, job met afwisseling, gsm, maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering.

Bekijk onze activiteiten: www.hevadexapplications.be

Kom vrijblijvend op gesprek bij ons.

We are a rapidly growing and dynamic company with 18 colleagues and market leader in waterproofing and air sealing in new construction and renovation projects.

Your main task is the application of solvent-free coatings, using spray/roll or brush techniques.... These coatings are used for waterproofing and airtightness of buildings, e.g. foundations, basement walls, etc. you will learn these techniques at our company, so experience is not mandatory. You always work together with an experienced colleague.

Our assets for you: job with variety, cell phone, meal vouchers, hospitalization insurance.

Come and talk to us without any obligation.

See our activities on: www.hevadexapplications.be

jobs.title: Electrical and Communication Engineering
jobs.description:
Role Overview:

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the Electrical discipline cover other construction areas as required. This includes ensuring compliance with design specifications, technical standards, and project requirements while aligning with cost, schedule, and safety objectives. Electrical Engineer closely collaborates with Plant Unit Project Managers, Construction Managers, and other cross-functional Technical Project Managers to ensure seamless integration of Electrical tasks.

Key responsibilities include managing contractors and suppliers, monitoring progress and costs, mitigating technical risks, electrical and communication design, and ensuring quality and documentation standards are met. The role also supports procurement with technical input, evaluates change requests, and drives continuous improvement by applying lessons learned.

Key Responsibilities:

· Manage all tasks related to the technical discipline, ensuring compliance with design specifications, technical standards, and project requirements.

· Ensure that all work aligns with design-to-cost and schedule objectives.

· Work with Plant Unit Project Managers and Construction Managers to integrate discipline-specific work into the overall plant unit, ensuring smooth coordination and alignment with plant unit goals.

· Provide updates on discipline-specific progress to the Technical Discipline Manager and escalate issues when necessary.

· Oversee the work of contractors and suppliers related to their discipline, ensuring that work is completed on time and to the required quality standards.

· Identify technical risks and work with both the Technical Discipline Manager and Plant Unit Project Manager to resolve issues and mitigate risks.

· Ensure all technical work is properly documented and that progress is reported regularly to the Plant Unit Project Manager and Technical Discipline Manager. Align with suppliers and contractors

· Making standard documents as per project requirements and as per standards

· Familiar with electrical engineering software like ETAP, SPF, and DIALUX.

· Familiar with SS EN Standards such as SS 4364000, SS EN 50522, SS EN 50110 Elsäkerhetsverket (ELSÄK-FS)

· In-depth knowledge of MV/LV power distribution systems and electrical equipment.

· Pre-commissioning for electrical equipment such as panels, transformers, motors, and so on.

· Familiar with the design and installation of switchgear, Transformers, cables, and bus ducts.

· Factory Acceptance Test witness in international companies.

· Strong knowledge of workplace safety & experience in a broad range of safety procedures.

· Ensure that all technical aspects align with project goals, including safety, budget, scope, and schedule.

· Provide expertise and guidance on discipline-specific methodologies and best practices.

· Support procurement with technical input during contract negotiations.

· Review and approve all deliverables within the discipline to ensure quality standards and specifications are met.

· Assess resource needs to ensure that project goals are met.

· Adjust team activities as necessary to meet project timelines and objectives.

· Identify areas for process improvements within the discipline.

· Implement lessons learned from past projects to enhance future performance.

Competencies and experience:

· Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.

· Minimum of 8 years of experience within the design, construction, and installation of Electrical systems.

· Good knowledge of the technical aspects of Electrical systems within industrial projects.

· Strong leadership and management skills.

· Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

· Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

· Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

· Possibility to start the assignment at short notice.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and cover letter to info@nordicteq.com with the subject line “Electrical and Communication Application – [Your Name]”.

jobs.title: Medvind assistanse søker deg som ønsker å jobbe som brukerstyrt personlig assistent i Bjørnafjorden!
jobs.description:
Medvind Assistanse AS søker etter flere Brukerstyrte Personlige Assistenter (BPA). Det er spennende og variert jobb som gir deg muligheten til å jobbe med mennesker med ulike behov og livssituasjoner. Perfekt for deg som er student og/eller er på jakt etter en hel- eller deltidsjobb!

Formell kompetanse er ikke nødvendig, vi er opptatt at hvem du er og hva du liker å gjøre. Her er det gode muligheter for å finne en arbeidsleder som har samme interesser som deg - og det kan bli en perfekt match! Når man matcher godt, ligger alt til rette for en trivelig arbeidsplass.

Akkurat nå ser vi etter tilkallingsvikarer til våre arbeidsledere! Som tilkallingsvikar er det viktig at du er fleksibel og har mulighet til å stille på kort varsel ved sykdom hos andre assistenter.

Vi setter pris på om du skriver litt om hvor mye og hvilken type vakter du kan jobbe i din søknad.

Hva er BPA?

BPA står for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse og er et likestillingsverktøy. Dette er en meningsfull jobb med varierte arbeidsoppgaver. Rollen går ut på at du som assistent bistår arbeidsleder med å være en aktiv deltaker på alle områder i samfunnet. I og med at mennesker er så forskjellige, vil også de ulike arbeidsplassene være forskjellige. Dagene vil variere, hvor man møter både rolige dager og mer aktive dager. Det er viktig at du kan tilpasse deg disse dagene. 

Arbeidsoppgaver kan innebære, men ikke begrenset til;

  • Personlig hygiene
  • Bistand i hjemmet
  • Vær med på aktiviteter
  • Vær med på arbeidsplassen
  • Være med på ulike sosiale arenaer
  • Vær med på reisen
  • Bistå med bilkjøring

Kort og greit, bistå der det er nødvendig!

Hvem ser vi etter?
Vi søker deg som er:

  • Ansvarlig, pliktoppfyllende og empatisk  
  • Liker å jobbe med mennesker
  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter
  • Selvstendig, men også en god lagspiller
  • Omsorgsfull, pålitelig og fleksibel
  • Utadvendt og positiv
  • Har et ønske om å gjøre en forskjell

Hvorfor er BPA perfekt for deg som student?

  • Deltidsarbeid med fleksible vakter:  Vi tilbyr et bredt spekter av vakter som passer til din timeplan.
  • Fleksibel oppstart:  Vi matcher deg med en ordning som passer din studieplan.
  • Praktisk erfaring:  Få verdifull arbeidserfaring som kan styrke din CV og fremtidige karrieremuligheter.
  • Meningsfylt arbeid:  Gjør en forskjell i noens liv ved å gi dem støtte og selvstendighet.

Er dette jobben for deg?
Vi ønsker å høre fra deg! Hvis du er motivert for å gjøre en positiv forskjell i andres liv, og har interesse for å være med å støtte mennesker med ulike behov, send inn søknad og CV til oss.

Vi kaller inn fortløpende til intervju, så ikke nøl med å sende inn din søknad i dag!

I Medvind Assistanse er vi stolte over å tilby våre ansatte:

  • Konkurransedyktig, tariffestet lønn som starter på 225,40 kr. per gang, med tillegg for kveld/natt og helg.
  • Medvind Assistanse er en solid leverandør av BPA-tjenester. Vi har lokalt tilstedeværelse over hele landet for å kunne være nær våre arbeidsledere og assistenter. Det er viktig for oss!
  • Arbeidsleders koordinator er også assistentens kontaktperson. Vi ønsker å ha gode relasjoner til både arbeidsledere og assistenter.
  • Et felles arbeidsmiljø med utviklingsmuligheter.
  • Enkle digitale systemer for vaktplan og tidsføring.
  • Ryddige forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.
  • Ansattgoder, som rabattert trening på Sats-sentre.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) d'Hôtel 5* (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi dans un établissement haut de gamme ?

Dans le cadre de son développement, notre client reconnu pour la qualité de son exigence et matière de service recherche son/sa futur(e) Directeur(trice) d'Hôtel pour son établissement situé au cœur du Piémont des Vosges, dans le Bas-Rhin (67).

Véritable ambassadeur(rice) de l'établissement, vous serez responsable de la gestion globale de l'hôtel, en collaboration étroite avec la direction, et veillerez à garantir une expérience client d'exception, tout en accompagnant les équipes dans une dynamique de performance, d'engagement et d'excellence opérationnelle.

Vos missions :
Management et encadrement des équipes
- Encadrer, fédérer et accompagner les équipes opérationnelles et supports (hébergement, réception, restauration, technique, administratif).
- Développer une culture d'excellence, de service et de cohésion.
- Assurer le recrutement, l'intégration, la formation et l'évolution des talents.
- Mettre en place un management de proximité favorisant la performance et l'implication des collaborateurs.

Pilotage et gestion de l'établissement
- Assurer la gestion globale de l'hôtel (exploitation, budget, rentabilité et qualité de service).
- Suivre et analyser les indicateurs de performance (chiffre d'affaires, taux d'occupation, coûts, satisfaction client).
- Élaborer les budgets annuels et définir les plans d'actions nécessaires.
- Garantir le respect des standards 5 étoiles ainsi que des procédures internes.

Gestion de l'information et reporting
- Structurer et analyser les données d'exploitation afin d'accompagner la prise de décision.
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la direction générale ou du groupe.
- Déployer des outils de suivi et de pilotage fiables et performants.

Expérience client et qualité de service
- Garantir une expérience client personnalisée et irréprochable à chaque étape du séjour.
- Superviser la qualité des prestations et le respect des standards d'un établissement haut de gamme.

Développement et performance de l'établissement
- Définir et déployer la stratégie de développement commercial et opérationnel .
- Optimiser la rentabilité tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence.
- Identifier les axes d'amélioration et piloter les projets d'évolution.




Profil recherché:
- Formation supérieure de niveau Bac +3 à Bac +5 en hôtellerie, tourisme ou management hôtelier.
- Expérience confirmée de 7 à 10 ans dans l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, incluant une expérience significative en tant que Directeur(trice) ou Directeur(trice) adjoint(e) d'un établissement 4 ou 5 étoiles.
- Excellentes compétences en management d'équipes, gestion d'exploitation et pilotage financier.
- Leadership naturel, sens du service, forte présence sur le terrain et capacité à fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs.
- Maîtrise des outils de gestion hôtelière et des principaux indicateurs de performance (RevPAR, taux d'occupation, chiffre d'affaires, coûts d'exploitation, etc.).
- Anglais courant indispensable, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, afin d'évoluer auprès d'une clientèle internationale.
- La maîtrise d'une troisième langue constitue un véritable atout.

Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service d'un établissement d'exception et contribuer activement à son développement ? N'attendez plus, adressez-nous votre candidature.

jobs.title: Market Risk Analyst (m/f)
jobs.description:
Market Risk Analyst (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1135

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

As 2nd line of defence, the Market and Liquidity Risk Management department supervises and independently organises the assessment, the monitoring and the reporting of the market and liquidity risks undertaken by the Bank. In addition, the department is in charge of the management of the dealing room front office tools (Kondor+ and Bloomberg).

The balance sheet management and client flow management activities are under the supervision of the department. Within this framework, the Market Risk Analyst is responsible for:

• Monitoring the market risk metrics within the defined limits.
• Computing and analysing the fair values and the P&L generated by the flow management activities (especially BIL Structured Products, Warrants and Foreign Exchange).
• Maintaining the internal market risk environment in line with the regulatory landscape.

Your next challenge:

• Daily reporting of the market risk exposures (e.g. sensitivities, VaR and stress tests) and analytical profit and loss to the senior management.
• Identify, investigate and document a wide range of market risk issues, including limit excesses and remediations or metrics calibrations.
• As part of the monthly accounting process, control fair values and hedge relationships.
• Take part in the overall risk reporting process, including SREP, ICAAP and Pillar 3 contributions.
• Provide ad-hoc analyses and simulations to support and challenge the 1st line of defence or to address Internal Audit, Internal Validation or regulatory requirements.
• Develop solutions and processes to monitor and challenge the derivatives and structured products valuations.
• Support the technical/functional testing and analyses required for the implementation of new projects, new products or a new reporting.
• Enhance and improve processes in the context of the market risk monitoring.

Your skills:

• Education (level): master's degree in finance, economics or mathematics.
• An experience of minimum 3 years in a similar function is mandatory
• Languages: fluent in French & English
• Very good understanding of financial products, including plain vanilla derivatives.
• Good knowledge of valuation techniques.
• Good knowledge of regulatory standards pertaining to market and counterparty risks.
• Accounting knowledge is an advantage.
• Knowledge of IRRBB framework (measures, methodologies, regulatory reporting…) is also an advantage.
• Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and VBA/SQL.
• Knowledge of Kondor+, RiskMetrics, Bloomberg, T24, Moody's Risk Confidence and Dataïku is an advantage.
• Propensity for teamwork and natural willingness to support the stakeholders within the team.
• Rigorous, innovative and curious.
• Result-oriented mindset striving to deliver on time.
• Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize accordingly.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.description:
Manager, Actuary - Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (Non-Life Insurance Specialization) (m/f/d)

Line of Service Assurance
Specialism Assurance
Management Level Manager

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Manager (m/f/d) in Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (ARMS). What if it was you?

The PwC Actuarial and Risk Modelling Services (ARMS) team in Luxembourg is looking for a manager with a background in non-life insurance and reinsurance expertise to join our local actuarial practice of over 20 actuaries and risk modellers. This is one of the largest actuarial consulting teams in Luxembourg. As part of our dynamic and diverse team, you will work on complex problems and challenges related to reserving, pricing, risk or capital projects across the Luxembourg and broader European markets, as well as multidisciplinary projects in areas such as reinsurance optimisation and business transactions.
Your role will involve working with the ARMS team on non-life insurance projects alongside colleagues from different teams with diverse backgrounds to provide our clients with the best possible solutions. Depending on the project, you will either manage it or carry out the analytical work yourself.

Be a part of our team where you will:

• Provide actuarial consulting services, including risk pricing, reinsurance optimisation, business plan review and development, claims reserve review, risk and capital modelling, and other actuarial projects.
• Perform IBNR reserving analysis, backtesting and valuation with a strong focus on business drivers, ensuring reserve adequacy aligns with regulatory requirements and translate technical insights into actionable recommendations for management and stakeholders.
• Support/lead Solvency II reviews for insurers, including Solvency II balance sheets, QRTs and ORSAs.
• Support insurance regulation-related projects as subject matter experts (SMEs) in reinsurance and non-life insurance, such as local regulation, IFRS 17 accounting, transfer pricing, POG/VFM, etc.
• Lead and deliver projects related to reinsurance strategy and optimization, including planning and pricing, and capital efficiency analysis.
• Work closely with audit teams to provide actuarial support to our audit practice with regard to Luxembourg-based insurers and reinsurers.
• Support the finance and tech transformation journeys of clients with subject matter expertise in reinsurance, risk pricing and reserving.
•  Lead and deliver actuarial projects focused on analyzing claims experience and development patterns, assessing reserving implications, and quantifying the impact on loss ratios and profitability to support strategic decision-making and improve overall efficiency.
• Support the Corporate Finance, M&A and Strategy teams by providing expert support for business transactions, portfolio transfers, actuarial due diligence projects and reserves/provision certifications.
• Assist in the continued growth and development of PwC's actuarial practice.
• Supervise and coach junior actuarial staff.

Let's talk about you. We expect that …

• You have significant progress in the examination process towards becoming a Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries or a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (or an equivalent actuarial association in a European country).
• You have at least 5 years of experience in reserving, pricing, capital or risk modelling in non-life insurance industry and/or consultancy. Alternatively, you have a background as a recognised non-life insurance consultant or have successfully delivered significant actuarial projects within the non-life insurance industry.
• You have practical experience with reinsurance, including planning, pricing, and optimisation, as well as Product design, risk transfer mechanisms, retrocession strategies, capital efficiency analysis, exposure modelling, and compliance with Solvency II and IFRS 17 frameworks.
• You demonstrate solid understanding of standard non-life actuarial practices under Solvency II, complemented by expertise in one or more related areas such as Luxembourg GAAP, IFRS 17 reporting, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
• You developed wider commercial awareness and understanding of the business and regulatory issues facing the non-life insurance industry.
• You enjoy working in a practical and creative manner, constantly analysing and solving new challenges. You inspire and retain clients thanks to your advisory skills.
• You have good command of the English language. Fluency in French is considered an advantage.
• You enjoy working in a team. You want to develop, build relationships and bring out the best in yourself and your colleagues.
• You are proficient in specialised non-life software in one of areas such as pricing, reserving, capital management (for example, URS, ResQ, or other recognised).

…so that you are the candidate we are looking for!

A final word about us:

At PwC, we believe diversity is the representation of all the characteristics that make us both alike and unique. Our backgrounds, cultures, nationalities, lifestyles, identities, opinions and beliefs, approaches to solving problems, ways of working, and views of personal and professional success, all add value to the services we deliver to our clients. Our objective is to nurture an inclusive environment where a diversity mindset is ingrained, and inclusion is the norm. We constantly focus on respecting and valuing individual differences.

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;
• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Let's talk about you. If you have/are:

• Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field;
• Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting;
• Possess strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulations, FATF standards, and global compliance frameworks;
• Bring proven experience in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud risk management, and investigations;
• Demonstrate excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities;
• Are fluent in English and French and/or German;
• Hold certifications such as CAMS, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or equivalent, which are highly desirable.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine” broj 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23. i 22/26.) i Odluci Upravnog vijeća (KLASA: 112-02/26-01/28, URBROJ: 2163-4-12-04-26-1 od 23. srpnja 2026. godine), Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin, raspisuje: NATJEČAJ ZA RADNO MJESTO ODGOJITELJ/ICA ♦ 2 (dva) izvršitelja/ice – na određeno, puno radno vrijeme, za pedagošku godinu 26./27. Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola, sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (“Narodne novine”, broj 82/08. i 69/17.). Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. UVJETI za radno mjesto odgojitelja/ice su: Prema članku 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ broj 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23. i 22/26.) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (“Narodne novine” broj 145/24. i 62/25.), završen studij odgovarajuće vrste za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti: a) sveučilišni prijediplomski studij, b) stručni prijediplomski studij, c) studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima, d) sveučilišni diplomski studij, e) stručni diplomski studij. Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava navedene uvjete, poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij, stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja i koja je završila program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi. Ako se na natječaj ne javi osoba koja ispunjava gore navedene uvjete, poslove odgojitelja može obavljati osoba koja je završila učiteljski studij, i to: sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ili četverogodišnji stručni studij primarnoga obrazovanja, uz uvjet da u roku od dvije godine od dana zasnivanja radnoga odnosa završi program za stjecanje odgojno-obrazovnih kompetencija za rad s djecom rane i predškolske dobi. Kandidati na natječaj trebaju dostaviti: - vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj s kontakt podacima (e - mail adresa i broj mobitela ili telefona), - životopis, - dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja/prebivališta) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne stariju od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika važeće osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice), - elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (ispis iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja. Prilikom eventualnog zaposlenja kandidata poslodavac utvrđuje zdravstvenu sposobnost radnika. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema posebnim propisima dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema odredbama članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. I 156/23.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. stavka 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji koji su dostupni na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21.), uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga dužni su priložiti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 180/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni da Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, obrađivati i koristiti osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe postupka natječaja sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direktive 95/46/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka) i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ broj 42/18.). Rok za podnošenje prijave je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se elektroničkom poštom na: tajnistvo@dvlabin.hr (uz naznaku: “Za natječaj”) ili osobno u ustanovu na adresu: Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin, Prilaz Kršin 2, Labin. Prijave koje se podnose osobno u ustanovu, dostavljaju se u zatvorenoj omotnici s naznakom: Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin – natječaj za odgojitelja/icu, za pedagošku godinu 26./27., ne otvarati.” Natječajna dokumentacija se neće vraćati kandidatima. Zakašnjele prijave kao i prijave s nepotpunom dokumentacijom neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja biti će pozvani na intervju. Kandidat koji ne pristupi intervjuu smatra se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom u natječajnom postupku. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem u zakonskom roku. Zadržava se pravo poništenja natječaja. Natječaj je objavljen dana 6. kolovoza 2026. i traje do 14. kolovoza 2026. godine.

O RASPISIVANJU NATJEČAJA

Članak 1.

UVJETI za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 1:

  • završen preddipplomski sveučilišni studij ili stručni studij predškolskog odgoja, odnosno studij odgovarajuće vrste kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s ranijim propisima ili završen sveučilišni diplomski studij ili diplomski specijalistički studij predškolskog odgoja

-uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti radnika ( prilikom eventualnog zaposlenja kandidata poslodavac utvrđuje zdravstvenu sposobnost radnika)

  • da nije pravomoćno osuđivan/a za kaznena djela iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19 i 57/22 ,101/23)

Uz pisanu i vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidati trebaju priložiti:

  • životopis
  • domovnicu
  • dokaz o vrsti i stupnju stručne spreme (diplomu), dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu,
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak ne starije od 6 mjeseci (potvrda o nekažnjavanju)
  • uvjerenje nadležnog prekršajnog suda da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi prekršajni postupak prema članku 25. stavak 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju,ne stariji od dana objave natječaja(NN 10/97, 107/07 i 94/13, 98/19 i 57/22, 101/23)

-potvrda Zavoda (Centra)za socijalnu skrb(prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere prema čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne stariji od dana objave natječaja

  • elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (ispis iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje)- ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja

jobs.title: VIŠI/A REFERENT/ICA ZA UPRAVNO PRAVNE POSLOVE I EU FONDOVE
jobs.description:
Jedinstveni upravni odjel KLASA: 112-03/26-01/4 URBROJ: 2163-40-01-01/17-26-1 Vrsar-Orsera, 06. kolovoza 2026. Temeljem članka 19. uz primjenu članka 29. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj ) samoupravi („Narodne novine“ br. 86/2008, 61/2011, 4/2018, 96/2018, 112/2019, 17/2025), dana 06.08.2026. godine, objavljuje se

OGLAS za prijam u službu na određeno vrijeme Jedinstveni upravni odjel Općine Vrsar-Orsera, raspisuje oglas za prijam u službu na radno mjesto viši referent za upravno pravne poslove i EU fondove – radno mjesto III. kategorije – viši referent – klasifikacijski rang 9. - 1 izvršitelj/izvršiteljica na određeno vrijeme od 6 mjeseci uz probni rad od 3 mjeseca, uz mogućnost produljenja za još 6 mjeseci radi poslova čiji se opseg privremeno povećao. Opći uvjeti za prijam u službu su:
  • punoljetnost,
  • hrvatsko državljanstvo,
  • zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima.
Osim općih uvjeta za prijam u službu kandidati moraju ispunjavati sljedeće posebne uvjete za prijam u službu: - sveučilišni prijediplomski studij ili stručni prijediplomski studij društvene struke - državni ispit II. razine - najmanje 1 godina radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima Na Oglas za prijam u službu – viši referent za upravno pravne poslove i EU fondove - u Jedinstveni upravni odjel u Općini Vrsar-Orsera (dalje u tekstu: Oglas) mogu se ravnopravno prijaviti kandidati oba spola, a izrazi koji se u ovom Oglasu koriste za osobe, u muškom su rodu i odnose se ravnopravno na oba spola. U službu ne mogu biti primljene osobe za koje postoje zapreke iz članka 15. i članka 16. Zakona. Osim navedenih stručnih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i uvjete utvrđene člancima 12.,13., 14., Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj ( regionalnoj) samoupravi (dalje:Zakon). Osoba koja nema položen državni stručni ispit dužna ga je položiti u roku godine dana od prijema u službu. Ako kandidat/kandidatkinja ostvaruje pravo na prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan/dužna je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kandidatkinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Prednost pod jednakim uvjetima ostvaruju osobe koje ispunjavaju uvjete iz čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. U slučaju isticanja prednosti temeljem ovog zakona kandidat mora dostaviti dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji, a sve sukladno „Popisu dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju“ objavljenom na poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidati su dužni priložiti sljedeće priloge:
  1. životopis
  2. dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (preslika domovnice ili preslika osobne iskaznice),
  3. dokaz o stručnoj spremi,
  4. dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu (presliku potvrde ili elektronički zapis o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje),
  5. uvjerenje Općinskog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak i da nije pravomoćno osuđen za kaznena djela iz čl. 15. st. 1. Zakona, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog Oglasa u Hrvatskom zavodu za zapošljavanje (izvornik ili ovjerena preslika),
  6. vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu da za prijam u službu ne postoje zapreke iz članka 15. i 16. Zakona,
  7. dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti
  8. dokaz o položenom državnom stručnom ispitu (ako ima položen)
  9. dokazi o ostvarivanju prava prvenstva Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenom presliku (osim priloga pod f. koji se dostavlja u izvorniku), a prije izbora kandidata predočit će se izvornik isprava. Napomena uz e): uvjerenje Općinskog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak dostavlja kandidat u prijavi, a uvjerenje da kandidat nije pravomoćno osuđen ishoduje Općina Vrsar-Orsera po služenoj dužnosti za odabranog kandidata Napomena uz g): Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti izabrani kandidat dostavlja prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu. Urednom prijavom smatra se vlastoručno potpisana prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u Oglasu. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz Oglasa, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na Oglas. S kandidatima prijavljenim na Oglas provest će se testiranje i intervju radi provjere znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta za koje se primaju. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na Oglas. Opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta, način obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata, područje provjere, te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za provjeru navedeni su na web-stranici www.vrsar.hr i na Oglasnoj ploči Općine Vrsar-Orsera. Prethodna pisana provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata biti će održana 27.08.2026. u 9.00 sati u prostorijama Općine Vrsar-Orsera. Radovi prethodne pisane provjere znanja će odmah biti obrađeni, te će se razgovori s kandidatima obaviti isti dan u 11.30, također u prostorijama Općine Vrsar-Orsera. Prijave na Oglas, s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta, dostavljaju se poštom ili osobno na adresu: Općina Vrsar-Orsera, Trg Degrassi 1, 52450 Vrsar u roku od 8 dana od objave Oglasa putem portala Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanja s obveznom naznakom: „Oglas za prijam u službu – viši referent za upravno pravne poslove i EU fondove - Jedinstveni upravni odjel Općine Vrsar-Orsera" Kandidati će o rezultatima Oglasa biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine”, broj 10/97., 107/07., 94/13., 98/19., 57/22., 101/23. i 22/26.) i Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (“Narodne novine”, broj 145/24. i 62/25.): - kvalifikacija razine 1 stečena završetkom osnovnog obrazovanja Kandidati na natječaj trebaju dostaviti: - vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj s kontakt podacima (e - mail adresa i broj mobitela ili telefona), - životopis, - dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja/prebivališta) da kandidatu nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne stariju od dana raspisivanja natječaja), - dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika važeće osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice), - elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (ispis iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja. Prilikom eventualnog zaposlenja kandidata poslodavac utvrđuje zdravstvenu sposobnost radnika. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema posebnim propisima dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema odredbama članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. stavka I. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji koji su dostupni na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“, broj 84/21.), uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga dužni su priložiti i dokaze iz stavka I. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 180/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni da Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, obrađivati i koristiti osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe postupka natječaja sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direktive 95/46/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka) i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“, broj 42/18.). Rok za podnošenje prijave je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se elektroničkom poštom na: tajnistvo@dvlabin.hr (uz naznaku: “Za natječaj”) ili osobno u ustanovu na adresu: Dječji vrtić “Pjerina Verbanac” Labin, Prilaz Kršin 2, Labin. Kandidat koji ne pristupi intervjuu smatra se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom u natječajnom postupku. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem u zakonskom roku. Zadržava se pravo poništenja natječaja.
