jobs.title: Jordemoderuddannelsen søger timelærere
jobs.description:
Kan du undervise indenfor fagområdet jordemoderkundskab/obstetrik samt vejlede og eksaminere? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler som timelærer på Jordemoderuddannelsen, Campus Slagelse.

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition at facilitere engagerende undervisning på et højt fagligt niveau og samtidig skabe læring og motivation. Som timelærer bliver du en del af en uddannelses - og arbejdskultur, hvor vi sætter de studerende først, værdsætter fællesskab og faglighed, og hvor uddannelsesprofessionalismen er tydelig i alt, hvad vi gør.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der er:

En selvstændig og struktureret underviser, der kan skabe trygge og motiverende læringsmiljøer for de studerende. Du er nysgerrig på nye undervisningsformer og anvender gerne simulation, digitale læringsplatforme og velfærdsteknologi.

En erfaren praktiker, der kan formidle komplekst fagligt stof på en engagerende og praksisnær måde og formår at koble teori med klinisk praksis.

God til at samarbejde og videndele, både med dine kolleger i form af samarbejder og erfaringsudveksling, men også med de studerende.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:
  • har en sundhedsfaglig baggrund (f.eks. jordemoder eller anden relevant sundhedsfaglig uddannelse) kombineret med relevant master- eller kandidatuddannelse
  • har stærke digitale kompetencer.

Har du erfaring med at undervise eller vejlede studerende, er det en fordel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som timelærer bliver du en del af et engageret underviserteam, hvor du - afhængigt af dine kompetencer - bidrager med følgende arbejdsopgaver:

Planlægge og gennemføre undervisning på grunduddannelsen med mulighed for også at indgå i undervisning på efter- og videreuddannelsesområdet. Du skal deltage i simulation og færdighedstræning. Undervisningen tager udgangspunkt i aktuelle kliniske problemstillinger og kobler teori, forskning, teknologi og praksis.

Vejlede studerende og bidrage til at skabe et engagerende studiemiljø på uddannelsen.

Eksaminere og bedømme studerende i forbindelse med uddannelsens teoretiske og kliniske prøver.

Udvikle undervisningsmaterialer og læringsaktiviteter som en del af et dynamisk læringsmiljø.

Dine kolleger
På Jordemoderuddannelsens udbud i Slagelse bliver du mødt af et dedikeret og fagligt stærkt team bestående af syv dygtige og fagligt engagerede kolleger, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe et stærkt fagligt og socialt miljø. Vi har fokus på kvalitet i undervisningen, tæt kobling til praksis og et stærkt læringsfællesskab for de studerende.

Vi er en del af Center for Sundhed, som udover jordemoderuddannelsen består af sygeplejerskeuddannelsen, ergoterapeutuddannelsen, ernæring- og sundhedsuddannelsen, fysioterapeutuddannelsen og den sundhedsadministrative koordinatoruddannelse. I centeret er vi tilsammen
  1. 140 ansatte.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende cirkulære om overenskomst for eksterne lektorer og timelærere ved professionshøjskoler, Danmarks Medie- og Journalisthøjskole og erhvervsakademiker m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet.
  • Timetallet aftales løbende, dog maksimalt 500 arbejdstimer per år.
  • Stillingen er tidsbegrænset for 3 år, og vi vil gerne have, at du begynder snarest muligt.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte uddannelsesleder Camilla Gry Temmesen på tlf.: 7248 2737
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest fredag den 21. august 2026.
  • Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: 🌿 Fast deltidsjobb som BPA-assistent hos aktiv familiefar

📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest

⏰ Arbeidstid: Dagtid, noe kveld og helg

Hei!

Jeg er en blid familiefar i 30-årene som bor sammen med kona og barnet vårt på Lørenskog. Nå ser jeg etter en trygg, engasjert og pålitelig BPA-assistent som ønsker å bli en del av hverdagen min.

Vi bor sentralt, bare noen minutters gange fra bussholdeplass, med gode kollektivforbindelser til Oslo. Hos oss er det en avslappet og hyggelig atmosfære, og vi håper å finne en assistent som ønsker å bidra til at jeg kan fortsette å leve et aktivt familieliv.

Jeg har diagnosen ALS og bruker både rullestol og pustemaskin. Jeg kan fortsatt snakke, men trenger assistanse til praktiske oppgaver og personlig bistand gjennom dagen. Som assistent blir du en viktig støtte, slik at jeg kan være en aktiv ektemann, pappa og delta i de aktivitetene som betyr mye for meg.

Når jeg har tid til overs, liker jeg blant annet båtliv, gaming, brettspill, teknologi og ishockey. Det er selvfølgelig ingen krav at du deler interessene mine, men det er en bonus om du setter pris på en hyggelig prat og litt humor i hverdagen.

Om stillingen

Jeg søker nå én fast assistent i en 20 % stilling.

Stillingen består av:

  • Arbeid én til to helger i måneden, hovedsakelig på dagtid.

  • Én til to vakter i ukedagene per måned, på dag- eller kveldstid.

Den nøyaktige turnusen avtales nærmere med riktig kandidat. Det er ønskelig med oppstart så snart som mulig.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som BPA-assistent vil du bistå meg med både praktiske og personlige oppgaver, blant annet:

  • Personlig stell og daglig bistand

  • Håndtering av pustemaskin og annet medisinsk utstyr (du får nødvendig opplæring)

  • Tilrettelegging for aktiviteter og familieliv

  • Følge til avtaler og ulike gjøremål

  • Enkle huslige oppgaver som oppvask, rydding og lett rengjøring

Hvem ser jeg etter?

For meg er personlig egnethet viktigere enn erfaring. Jeg ser etter deg som:

  • Er trygg, rolig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Er positiv og samarbeidsvillig

  • Tar initiativ når det trengs

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med å jobbe tett på mennesker

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Gyldig politiattest må kunne fremvises

  • Førerkort klasse B (automatgir)

  • Behersker norsk godt, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt

Vi tilbyr

  • 💰 Lønn etter tariff:

    • Timelønn: 236,49 kr

    • Kveldstillegg: 67 kr

    • Helgetillegg: 70 kr

  • 📚 Grundig opplæring og relevante kurs

  • 🎁 Fordelsportal med rabatter hos blant annet hoteller, nettbutikker og hvitevareforhandlere

  • 🤝 Tett oppfølging fra BPA-koordinator

  • 🌟 En meningsfull jobb hvor du blir en viktig del av hverdagen til meg og familien min

Søknad

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og ansetter så snart vi finner riktig kandidat.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, kan du kontakte rekrutterer Petter Ariel Skog på e-post: petter.skog@mio.no.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

jobs.title: Associate Site Manager / Site Engineer

jobs.title: Assistant Professor Position in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering
jobs.description:
SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering. SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The position is available from January 1, 2027, with the specific start date to be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

 

The position and research environment 

You will join the maritime group at Mechanical Engineering, where the main research topics are seakeeping, data-driven maintenance, and energy systems and efficiency. The group works within applied research, carried out in close collaboration with industry and other research groups. The group is part of the larger Maritime Center at SDU, offering strong opportunities for transdisciplinary and cross-faculty collaboration. In addition, the center is actively developing strong relationships with external partners. The candidate is expected to play an active role in this community, contributing both to research and administrative activities within the center. This includes outreach to other universities, industry, maritime educational institutes, authorities, and professional organizations to establish and strengthen collaborative relationships.

Furthermore, SDU conducts defense-related research. The successful candidate is therefore expected to have an interest in dual-use research within the relevant research fields, and to actively engage in outreach to other universities as well as the Danish Defence.

To complement our team, we are looking for candidates within naval architecture and marine engineering / mechanical engineering, with documented research experience in one of the following fields:

  • Data-driven operation of ships – Energy efficiency and predictive maintenance, digital twins, and the use of machine learning and sensor data to optimize vessel operation and efficiency.

  • Seakeeping and comfort onboard vessels - ship motion analysis, ship stability, vibration and noise reduction, or human comfort and habitability at sea.

You will bring competence and dedication to teaching and student supervision in mechanical engineering at SDU ME, actively contributing to our two educational programs: Bachelor of Engineering (diplomingeniør) and Bachelor's and Master of Science (civilingeniør). Our engineering programs combine theory courses with project work, and you will be involved in both. 

 

Workplace

SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The research activities at SDU ME span widely from fluid mechanics, multi-physics simulation and optimization to condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and naval architecture and marine engineering. IME is a multidisciplinary department covering also high-frequency electronics, microelectronics, batteries and super-capacitors, additive manufacturing, smart structures and energy technologies. The department is an exciting environment, where you will be exposed to many different fields and have your general academic curiosity stimulated.

The position is full-time and located at the SDU main campus in Odense. Given the research, teaching, and collaborative nature of the position, you are expected to be present on campus on a regular basis and to relocate to Denmark, if currently residing abroad.

SDU Odense is the university’s largest campus and provides a strong framework for interdisciplinary research, teaching, and innovation. You will be part of a modern workplace with high professionalism, strong academic communities, and a commitment to diversity and equal opportunities. SDU also offers dedicated support for International Staff. Learn more about careers and work life at SDU here: Careers at SDU.

 

What we expect 

You must have:

  • Completed a PhD degree in a relevant discipline

  • The ability to teach basic mechanical engineering curricula

  • Communication skills in English at an adequate level for research communication and teaching

It is preferred that you also have experience from/with:

  • Postdoctoral research positions

  • Co-supervision of PhD students

  • Teaching and course development

  • Funding applications

  • Collaboration with industrial partners

You are expected to apply for own grants and to contribute to joint applications with the group and its collaborators. Strong potential to compete for national and international research funding is essential.

During the period of employment as Assistant Professor, you are expected to develop an independent research profile; publish high-quality research outputs; contribute to attracting external research funding; develop documented teaching and supervision competences, including completion of the Lecturer Training Programme; and contribute actively to collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the academic environment at SDU Mechanical Engineering.

 

Further information 

For more information about the position, contact Head of Section Associate Professor Dorte Smedegaard Schmidt (phone +45 65507432, e-mail dss@sdu.dk) or Professor Marie Lützen (phone +45 65509625, e-mail mlut@sdu.dk).

For more information about SDU ME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/da/mechanical.

For more information about IME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime. 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application (up to 2 pages). 

  • Complete Curriculum Vitae (up to 4 pages).

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications. 

  • Up to 10 publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • A proposed research plan (up to 4 pages).

  • References/reference letters may be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

jobs.title: Pizza Chefs Wanted – Full-time & Part-time
jobs.description:
Pizza Chefs Wanted – Full-time & Part-time

Passionate about authentic wood-fired pizza? Do you thrive in a fast-paced kitchen and take pride in your craft?

At Mio, we produce between 700 and 1100 authentic wood-fired pizzas every day across our two takeaway locations in Copenhagen. We work with traditional wood-fired pizza ovens, quality ingredients, and skilled craftsmanship to deliver exceptional pizzas with consistency and character.

We are looking for experienced Pizza Chefs who are passionate about quality, teamwork, and creating great pizzas at a consistently high standard.

About Mio & Waldorf Group

Mio is a takeaway pizza concept and part of Waldorf Group, with two locations in Copenhagen. Every day, we combine premium ingredients, authentic wood-fired baking, efficient operations, and strong craftsmanship to create outstanding pizzas for our guests.

Waldorf Group operates 17 places divided between restaurants and takeaway concepts. Across all our concepts, our mission is simple: to create great dining experiences through quality food, excellent service, and skilled craftsmanship. We offer a dynamic workplace with high standards, a fast pace, and opportunities to grow.

About the Role

As a Pizza Chef at Mio, you will play a key role in our daily production, working with traditional wood-fired pizza ovens alongside an experienced team. You will help ensure that every pizza meets our quality standards — even during our busiest services.

Your Responsibilities

  • Preparing, topping, and baking pizzas in traditional wood-fired ovens

  • Managing the oven during service and ensuring consistent baking quality

  • Preparing ingredients and daily mise en place

  • Maintaining high quality and consistency throughout service

  • Working closely with the team to ensure an efficient production flow

  • Following food safety, hygiene, and HACCP procedures

  • Keeping the kitchen clean, organized, and efficient

We’re Looking For Someone Who

  • Has previous experience as a Pizza Chef

  • Has experience working with wood-fired pizza ovens (preferred)

  • Works efficiently without compromising on quality

  • Thrives in a high-volume, fast-paced kitchen

  • Is reliable, responsible, and a strong team player

  • Takes pride in craftsmanship and attention to detail

What We Offer

  • Full-time and part-time positions

  • A stable position in a growing hospitality group

  • The opportunity to work with authentic wood-fired pizza ovens

  • A professional yet informal working environment

  • Great colleagues and a strong team culture

  • Opportunities for development and career growth

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus staff benefits

Interested?

Send your CV or a short introduction to nicolai@waldorfgroup.dk.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as we find the right candidates.

Join Mio and help us create authentic wood-fired pizzas every day.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
ETSIMME LAUKAAN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON OSA-AIKAISEEN TYÖHÖN

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana. Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------
Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

jobs.title: Transport Planner
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Ward Waste Products is seeking an experienced and motivated Transport Supervisor to oversee the day-to-day operation of our transport fleet and driving team. The successful candidate will ensure that waste collection and transport services are delivered safely, efficiently, and in compliance with all relevant legislation. The Transport Supervisor will play a key role in supporting drivers, coordinating operational activities, maintaining high service standards, and driving continuous improvement across the transport function. Key Responsibilities * Supervise the daily activities of drivers and transport operations to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently, and on schedule. * Support the Transport Planner in coordinating vehicle allocations, route planning, and resource deployment. * Monitor fleet movements and respond promptly to operational issues, vehicle breakdowns, traffic delays, or customer service requirements. * Conduct daily driver briefings and debriefings, ensuring all operational information is communicated effectively. * Ensure compliance with Road Safety Authority (RSA) regulations, driver hours, tachograph requirements, waste transport legislation, and company policies. * Monitor driver performance, attendance, and compliance with safety procedures, providing coaching and support where required. * Assist with driver recruitment, induction, training, and ongoing performance development. * Coordinate vehicle inspections, defect reporting, servicing, and maintenance in conjunction with the workshop team. * Investigate and report accidents, incidents, near misses, and customer complaints, implementing corrective actions where necessary. * Maintain accurate operational records, transport documentation, and compliance reports. * Promote a strong health, safety, and environmental culture throughout the transport operation. * Work closely with operations, customer service, and depot teams to ensure customer expectations are consistently met. * Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance service delivery. Skills & Experience Essential * Previous experience in a transport, logistics, or fleet supervisory role. * Strong leadership and people management skills. * Good understanding of transport legislation, driver hours, and fleet compliance requirements. * Excellent organisational, planning, and problem-solving abilities. * Strong communication skills with the ability to manage and motivate teams. * Proficient in Microsoft Office and transport management systems. * Ability to work under pressure and make sound operational decisions. Desirable Experience within the waste management, recycling, or environmental services sector. Knowledge of route optimisation software and GPS fleet tracking systems. CPC qualification or understanding of transport compliance requirements.

jobs.title: HR & Compliance Analyst
jobs.employer: A&M HOGS HEAD GOLF CLUB LIMITED
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Responsibilities Collect, model, and analyse HR data across headcount, turnover, absence, recruitment, training completion, and labour costs, and translate findings into clear reporting for the HR Manager and General Manager. Build and maintain HR dashboards and management reports, identifying trends, anomalies, and cost or risk drivers. Produce workforce planning analysis to support annual headcount, budget, and HR strategy decisions in partnership with the HR Manager. Benchmark HR metrics against hospitality and golf sector best practice and advise on performance gaps. Analyse and monitor compliance of employee records and HR processes against company policy, employment law, and data protection obligations. Conduct regular audits of HR systems and files, quantify areas of non-compliance, and recommend corrective action with defined timelines. Maintain audit-ready documentation and produce compliance reporting for management review. Assess the confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity of employee data held across all HR systems. Review existing HR processes and policies, model their effectiveness, and recommend data-driven improvements to strengthen consistency and reduce risk. Support the development, implementation, and evaluation of company policies and procedures, measuring adoption and impact. Analyse Schoox training-system data to track mandatory-training completion, identify gaps by department, and report on remediation. Provide analysis-led guidance to Heads of Department on HR, compliance, and workforce matters. Present findings, risks, and recommendations to management in a clear, evidence-based format. Investigate and analyse employee-relations and complaint data alongside the HR Manager to surface root causes and systemic issues, escalating complex legal matters to external counsel. Support recruitment analysis, including time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and selection reporting, in conjunction with the HR Manager. Perform other analytical duties as assigned by management. About You Third-level qualification in Human Resource Management, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Minimum of 1 years of basic experience in an HR or compliance role. Demonstrable ability to collect, model, and interpret data and turn it into actionable recommendations. Sound knowledge of HR best practice, and data protection requirements. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with HR information systems, reporting, or dashboarding tools an advantage. Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and a methodical, evidence-based approach. jobs.title: Dagtilbud Sydøst, Børnehuset Klarupvej, beliggende i Klarup søger pædagog til en begivenhedsansættelse.
jobs.description:
Dagtilbud Sydøst, Børnehuset Klarupvej, beliggende i Klarup søger pædagog til en begivenhedsansættelse.

37 timer pr. uge fra 1. september 2026 eller snarest herefter.

Vi søger en kollega til vores børnehus, i en begivnhedsansættelse, som vil være med til at gøre en forskel for børns hverdag. Vi søger dig der med dit rolige og nærværende udtryk, vil være med til at skabe rammerne for børns deltagelsesmuligheder, trivsel, læring, udvikling og dannelse – sammen med engagerede og fagligt stærke kollegaer.

Du skal kunne se børns behov og potentialer og hjælpe dem med at bringe deres ressourcer i spil i relationer og legefællesskaber. Vi leder efter dig, der er stærk i dit relationsarbejde og som kan være med til at skabe struktur og forudsigelighed i hverdagen.

Vi søger dig, der vil være en del af et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok, er nysgerrige på hinandens praksis og deler viden og erfaringer med hinanden. Vi tror på, at et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab er afgørende for både trivsel og faglig udvikling – og vi forventer, at du som kommende kollega har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til dette. Du skal have lyst til at arbejde i et hus, hvor vi hele tiden udvikler os – sammen.

Dit nye job

Børnehuset Klarupvej er normeret til 80 børnehavebørn, fordelt på fire aldersintegrerede stuer. Du vil blive tilknyttet en stue, hvor du sammen med dine kollegaer er ansvarlig for stuens drift, herunder opstartssamtaler, opfølgningssamtaler, dialogmøder, trivselsevalueringer, sprogvurderinger, planlægning osv. Du skal kunne arbejde med børns deltagelsesmuligheder i forskellige kontekster og grupper, og være fleksibel i forhold til at støtte børn dér, hvor behovet opstår. Det kræver, at du trives i et miljø med alsidige og omskiftelige opgaver, og at du ser samarbejde og faglig sparring som en naturlig del af hverdagen.

I Børnehuset Klarupvej arbejder vi målrettet med at styrke børns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse gennem nære, omsorgsfulde og anerkendende relationer og stærke fællesskaber. Vi møder børnene med respekt og tager udgangspunkt i deres ressourcer og potentialer – med en grundlæggende tro på, at alle børn gør det bedste, de kan. Det er de voksne, der har ansvaret for at skabe rammer, der understøtter børnenes deltagelse og udvikling. 

Du skal kunne omsætte pædagogiske principper og metoder til konkret praksis, og være med til at understøtte børn, der af den ene eller anden årsag bliver udfordret i hverdagen og i fællesskabet.

Hele personalegruppen har i efteråret 2024 deltaget i et undervisningsforløb i Nest, som har styrket vores fælles pædagogiske fundament og tilgang. Det er en fordel, du har kendskab til, og gerne erfaring med Nest, men dette er ikke et krav. Lige nu er vi i gang med en spændende udviklingsproces, hvor vi kvalificerer vores pædagogiske praksis yderligere med fokus på struktur, forudsigelighed og visuel guidning, som skaber tryghed og tydelighed for børnene, en proces som vi forventer du tager aktiv del i.

Din nye arbejdsplads

Børnehuset Klarupvej er en nyrer institution, som står rigtig flot, med lækre og gode faciliteter. Indendørs byder institutionen på, gode store rum, som både indbyder til leg, fordybelse, kreativitet og bevægelse. Udendørs har vi en stor og dejlig legeplads, som er indrettet med plads til bevægelse, hyggekroge og bålplads. Nederst på legepladsen har vi et område, med træer, buske og gode ”gemmesteder”, hvor børnene især elsker at lege. 

Vi har madordning fra eget produktionskøkken, hvor vores kostfaglige eneansvarlige sørger for mad til hele dagen. 

I Børnehuset Klarupvej vægter vi forældresamarbejdet højt. Vi prioriterer et tæt, åbent og positivt samarbejde med forældrene omkring barnets trivsel, læring, udvikling og dannelse. Vi ser forældrene som vigtige samarbejdspartnere og arbejder aktivt for at skabe tillidsfulde relationer, hvor dialog og gensidig respekt er i centrum.

 

Arbejdspladsens adresse: Børnehuset Klarupvej, Klarupvej 5, 9270 Klarup.

Der forventes at du kan møde i hele institutionens åbningstid 6:15-16:45 samt til 19:45 ved personalemøder, som finder sted ca. hver 4 uge.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen er omfattet af lokal løn. Øvrige ansættelsesforhold efter gældende regler mellem KL og FOA.

Forud for endelig ansættelse indhentes der staffe- og børneattest.

For yderligere information kontakt Pædagogisk Leder Nanna Hjørringgaard, 22714230.

Ansøgningsfrist er onsdag den 19. august 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler tirsdag den 20. august fra kl. 14.00.


Forud for ansættelse, indhenter vi referencer.

                              


Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.


Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder
Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.
Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

jobs.title: Er du massør med passion for dit fag? Bliv en del af CityFys i Herning!

Vi tror på kontinuerlig udvikling og opfordrer dig til at eksperimentere med forskellige massageteknikker, der passer til hver kundes unikke behov. Hos os bliver du en del af vores "lille-STORE-familie" – et team af professionelle behandlere, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe den bedste oplevelse for kunderne.

Vi værdsætter både personlig og faglig vækst, og vi skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor din passion for at hjælpe andre bliver anerkendt og belønnet.

Hos CityFys er vores mål at være Danmarks bedste arbejdsplads for massører og levere kvalitetsbehandlinger til vores kunder.

Vi tilbyder hurtig tiltrædelse og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

CityFys A/S er Danmarks en af største leverandør af massageordninger og betjener flere af landets største virksomheder. Vi har været i branchen siden 1999 og driver egne wellnessafdelinger i DGI Huset Herning, Wellness København og Water & Wellness Randers.

jobs.title: Søges: To medarbejdere til vores rengøringsteam, Middelfart, Denmark
jobs.description:
Rengøringsmedarbejder hos Noordwind Galsklint Strand Camping.

Er du vild med camping, naturen og at omgås mennesker? Har du sans for struktur og kan du godt lide at give en hånd med? Vi søger to personer, der sammen som et fast team står for rengøringen og deler arbejdet ligeligt mellem sig – så er du måske lige den rette til at styrke os.

Dine opgaver:

  • Rengøring af sanitetsområder, køkkener, receptionen og butikken

  • Rengøring af hytterne, når gæsterne er tjekket ud

  • Påfyldning af forbrugsartikler

  • Overvågning af forbruget og indberetning ved mangler

  • Indberetning af defekter eller ønsker om ændringer i arbejdsgange, materialer osv.

  • Støtte til pladslederen

  • Mulighed for flere arbejdstimer:

  • Hvis du ønsker det, kan du påtage dig yderligere opgaver – i så fald øger vi det ugentlige timetal eller din løn tilsvarende.



Vi forventer, at du:

  • taler dansk eller engelsk

  • er venlig, selvstændig og serviceorienteret

  • har erfaring med eller interesse for rengøringsbranchen.



Det tilbyder vi:

  • En fast plads i et team på to, der deler arbejdet ligeligt – I skiftes til vagterne og holder altid fri på skift

  • Fast gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid med timekonto: i gennemsnit ca. 10 timer om ugen pr. person – mest i højsæsonen (juli–august, op til ca. 20 timer/uge), mindre om vinteren (ca. 3 timer/uge), når I tager ferie og udnytter kompensationsfrihed. jobs.title: Technical Manager - DTU Management
jobs.description:
Experience in tool building for digital methods, controversy mapping, computational social science.

We are looking for an experienced technical manager to manage and develop the technical infrastructure of the Observatory for Technological Questions in Society. The observatory has taken on a 2-year strategic development project in collaboration with the central communications department at DTU to map public debates about technology in Denmark and help support the participation of DTU’s research and expertise in those debates. You will be collaborating with researchers in the observatory to build the technical platform for this project and develop continuous controversy mapping as a research agenda.

Skilled technical lead for the Observatory for Technological Questions in Society

Primary areas of responsibility:
  • Organize and lead technical operations in the observatory
  • Coordinate work with the central communications department on strategic development project
  • Develop and maintain technical infrastructure for continuous analysis and visualization of societal debate about technology.

Our expectations of you

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience as a technical manager from computational social science / digital methods labs, especially supporting interdisciplinary research collaborations with an STS component, and have deep expertise in the following technical areas:
  • Large language models and natural language processing
  • Visualization of unstructured data (text) and exploratory data visualization
  • Open-source tool development

What we offer in return

We offer a dynamic and international work environment in the Observatory for Technological Questions in Society (ECHOlab), the Division for Technology and Business Studies, and the Department of Management. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. As part of the project you will be working on, you will be supporting the implementation of the university’s strategy in collaboration with other departments at DTU, providing a unique opportunity for interdisciplinary exchange across a wide range of subject areas.

Salary and appointment terms

The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

You are employed as an Senior Officer. The position is a 2-year full-time position. Starting date is 1 September 2026 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact

Please submit your online application no later than Thursday 20 August 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Professor, Anders Krisitian Munk by e-mail: ankm@dtu.dk or phone: (+45) 26 74 29 79.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Management conducts excellent research at the intersection of management, technology and economics. We develop solutions in close cooperation with companies and public authorities. Our research aims at strengthening welfare, productivity and sustainability. A key element is the role of technology and its interaction with industry and individuals. The department offers a wide range of courses and programs at bachelor, master, and PhD levels across DTU's study programs. The department has 250+ employees with around half of staff coming from abroad.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829

DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Service-superhelt søkes
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en variert arbeidshverdag der service, vertskap og samarbeid står i fokus? Vi ser etter en engasjert og serviceinnstilt resepsjonist som ønsker å gi våre gjester en hyggelig opplevelse – fra ankomst til avreise.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som resepsjonist vil du være hotellets ansikt utad og ha en sentral rolle i den daglige driften. Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Ta imot gjester og gjennomføre inn- og utsjekk.

  • Betjene resepsjon og bar, fra servering av kaffe til enklere drinker og alkoholservering i henhold til gjeldende regelverk.

  • Besvare henvendelser via telefon, e-post og i resepsjonen.

  • Selge hotellrom samt bidra til mersalg av mat, drikke og andre produkter.

  • Utføre administrative resepsjonsoppgaver, inkludert oppgjør, ankomst- og avreiselister, sjekklister, håndtering av spesielle forespørsler og koordinering med hotellets øvrige avdelinger.

  • Bidra til å ivareta sikkerhet og gode rutiner ved hotellet.

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har en positiv og serviceorientert innstilling.

  • Trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team.

  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Helst har fagbrev innen hotell, resepsjon eller annen servicebransje.

  • Er fylt 20 år.

  • Er strukturert, lærevillig og løsningsorientert

Vi tilbyr

  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag med mange ulike arbeidsoppgaver.

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med gode utviklingsmuligheter.

  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging fra erfarne kollegaer.

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og attraktive personalfordeler.

  • Lønn etter tariff

  • Arbeid hovedsakelig på dag- og kveldsvakter på hverdag og helg, med mulighet for nattarbeid ved behov.

Hos oss blir du en del av et positivt arbeidsmiljø med stor takhøyde, godt samarbeid og varierte dager. Vi tilbyr en arbeidsplass der du får ansvar, mulighet til å utvikle deg og trygghet gjennom god opplæring. Samtidig blir du en viktig del av et engasjert team som sammen skaper gode opplevelser for våre gjester.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Best Western Plus Oslo Airport er et moderne konferanse- og flyplasshotell som ligger kun få minutter fra Oslo lufthavn Gardermoen. Hotellet betjener både forretningsreisende, kurs- og konferansegjester samt privatpersoner med tidlige eller sene flyavganger.

Vi tilbyr komfortable rom, tidlig frokost, shuttlebuss til flyplassen, gode parkeringsmuligheter og møte- og konferansefasiliteter med kapasitet for opptil 220 deltakere. I hotellets restaurant, Ravinen, serveres sesongbaserte retter, og hotellet har også barception, treningsrom og sosiale fellesområder.

Som arbeidsplass er vi preget av høyt tempo, tett samarbeid på tvers av avdelinger og sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og bærekraft.

jobs.title: Lærer/pedagog søkes til BPA-team i Gratangen – attraktiv turnus med lange friperiode
jobs.description:
Litt om meg

Jeg er en 12 år gammel gutt som bor sammen med familien min i Gratangen. Gratangen er ei nydelig lita bygd omtrent én times kjøring fra Narvik, med flotte turområder og gode muligheter for jakt og fiske.

Jeg går for tiden ikke på skolen og trenger derfor en trygg voksenperson hjemme på dagtid. Du vil bidra med nødvendig og individuelt tilpasset opplæring. Mye av læringen vil være knyttet til ADL-trening – altså praktiske ferdigheter som fremmer mestring, utvikling og størst mulig selvstendighet i hverdagen.

Opplæringen må tilpasses mine behov, dagsform og forutsetninger. I tillegg vil du utføre andre BPA-oppgaver og bistå meg med det jeg trenger gjennom dagen.

Som lærer eller pedagog i BPA-teamet mitt får du en viktig rolle. Du bidrar med pedagogisk kompetanse, struktur og forutsigbarhet og legger til rette for gode opplevelser, læring og utvikling.


Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid

Stillingsprosent er ledig opptil 100 %, dersom ønskelig. Oppgi gjerne i søknaden hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe – både deltids- og heltidsstilling er aktuelt.

Vi skreddersyr turnus i samarbeid med deg og tilrettelegger for lengre friperioder. Et eksempel kan være lange vakter i 4 dager, etterfulgt av 7 dager fri. Du får disponere en egen leilighet uten kostnad til bruk i pauser og overnatting ved behov.

Dette kan være stillingen for deg som ønsker å bruke lærer- eller pedagogkompetansen din på en nær, praktisk og meningsfull måte – og samtidig bli en viktig del av et trygt BPA-team.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Skape trygghet, struktur og forutsigbarhet i hverdagen
  • Tilrettelegge individuelt tilpassede læringsaktiviteter, med særlig vekt på ADL-trening, mestring og selvstendighet
  • Bistå med daglige rutiner som måltider, personlig hygiene, påkledning og hvile
  • Forebygge stress og uro gjennom god planlegging og pedagogisk tilrettelegging
  • Delta i lek, fritidsaktiviteter, turer og reiser
  • Observere og dokumentere utvikling samt bidra til gode rutiner og tiltak
  • Samarbeide tett med familien og de øvrige assistentene
  • Veilede og gi faglig støtte til familien og BPA-teamet
  • Støtte arbeidsleder (mor) i praktiske og administrative oppgaver knyttet til BPA-ordningen

Vi ser etter deg som
  • er utdannet lærer eller pedagog med relevant bachelorutdanning
  • har førerkort klasse B
  • er trygg, tålmodig, engasjert og strukturert
  • kan tilpasse aktiviteter og opplæring til individuelle behov
  • ønsker å bruke den pedagogiske kompetansen din utenfor det tradisjonelle klasserommet
  • trives med å arbeide tett sammen med et barn og familien
  • bidrar til stabilitet, samarbeid og gode rutiner

Andre relevante bachelorutdanninger kan også være aktuelle. Erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge med sammensatte behov er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.


Mye mer enn bare penger

Visste du at med erfaring fra jobben som personlig assistent er du ettertraktet også i andre jobber?

Når du jobber så tett på mennesker som assistenter gjør, får du en helt egen kunnskap om relasjonsbygging. Du får kunnskap og erfaringer som er unik og verdsatt i arbeidslivet! All arbeidserfaring er relevant for BPA assistenter. Vi mener at BPA ikke er en helsetjeneste, våre BPA-assistenter skal bidra til at våre vedtakseiere hver dag får en bedre hverdag!

Hva du får som assistent i BPA Nord:

  • Sikre deltids- og heltidsstillinger | Varierte arbeidstider
  • Kurs og god opplæring | Assistentmanual
  • Timelønn som ligger over gjennomsnittet i liknende jobber
  • Kompetanseutvikling via gratis E-læringskurs
  • Kveld/natt/helg- og helligdagstillegg
  • Pensjonsavtale for alle ansatte uavhengig av stillingsstørrelse
  • Personalforsikringer (Yrkesskade, Fritidsskade, Gruppeliv og DNBs døgnkontinuerlige Helsetelefon)
  • Verneombud | Bedriftshelsetjeneste
  • Enkle digitale registreringssystemer
  • En ekte nordnorsk arbeidsgiver – nær, varm og på lag med deg

Vil DU bidra til en bedre hverdag for mennesker med assistansebehov, samtidig som du får en spennende CV?
Søk assistentjobb hos BPA Nord!


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kompetanse  |  Anerkjennelse  |  Respekt  |  Tillit

BPA Nord er leverandør av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) i en rekke nordnorske kommuner.
Vi er i alt ca. 600 ansatte fordelt på avdelingene i Tromsø, Alta, Bardu, Fauske, Gratangen, Hammerfest, Harstad, Karlsøy, Kautokeino, Kvæfjord, Kvænangen, Kåfjord, Leirfjord, Loppa, Lyngen, Meløy, Målselv, Narvik, Nordreisa, Porsanger, Rana, Saltdal, Senja, Skjervøy, Sortland, Storfjord, Sørreisa, Tjeldsund, Vågan og Øksnes.

Vår visjon er en bedre hverdag!

jobs.title: Engine Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Engine Automation Engineer with the main responsibility of engineering solutions for customer engines. This permanent position is part of the R&D and Engineering organization, and the position is located in Vaasa, Finland.

Modern diesel- and gas engines have an embedded engine automation system which forms an essential part of the engine and ensures optimal performance and functionality of the engine. The automation system is specifically configured for each delivery engine to meet the needs for each individual customer application.

We are offering technically interesting and challenging work with good opportunities to contribute to the development of the operations.


Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Act as engine automation expert for defined engine types
* Create and test engine automation software configurations for customer delivery projects and maintain related databases and documentation
* Support engine production and engine factory testing in advanced troubleshooting of engine automation systems
* Take part in the execution of customer projects through correspondence and participation in meetings with internal stakeholders and sub-suppliers
* Coordinate and supervise design and deliveries from sub-suppliers
* Support and assist with the commissioning at the customer sites
* Provide technical support for our sales- and supply management organizations regarding engine automation
* Participate in development projects and cooperate with other expert teams in the areas of engine performance, engine design, software development and technical service



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Excellent communication and cooperation skills
* Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as part of a team
* Logical thinking and systematic way of working
* Ability to take initiatives and act independently with accuracy in work
* Fluency in verbal and written English as well as Finnish or Swedish
* Motivation to learn and grow professionally
* Good knowledge of basic office tools and willingness to learn other engineering tools
* Technical education, MSc or BSc in electrical/automation engineering, or similar
* Experience of working with internal combustion engines and related automation systems



We offer:

* A working environment with highly skilled and friendly colleagues
* Interesting work with a mix of: Independent behind-the-desk office work
* Hands-on practical work with testing in rigs as well as troubleshooting on real production engines in manufacturing and engine test runs
* Interaction with customers in cooperation with colleagues in e.g. project- and site management

* Appropriate tools and working spaces
* A variety of training activities, learning solutions, self-study materials and on-the-job training for personal competence development


Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you before the application deadline 23rd of August 2026 by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

jobs.title: Restaurant ONE TEN forstærker køkkenet
jobs.description:
Efter snart 3 år siden åbningen er Restaurant ONE TEN Providence nu klar til vol.2. Søger i den forbindelse en dygtig a la carte kok, der kan håndtere det varme parti.

ONE TEN er et lille familieejet fine dining restaurant inspireret af det franske og nordiske køkken. Blot 10 retter på kortet (plus plateau de fromage), hvor enkelte af retterne skifter efter sæson. dynamisk samarbejde med tjenerstaben, der flamberer og rører tartar tableside blandt gæsterne. Med så få retter er der ekstrem fokus på smag og sammensætninger. Her bruges ikke molekylær gastronomi, men søger i stedet at præsentere det smukke i råvarernes mere naturlige egenskaber.

ONE TEN var allerede Københavns bedst anmeldte restaurant på Google og TripAdvisor blot 1 år efter åbningen. I 2025 blev Restaurant ONE TEN yderligere tildelt "best of the best" af TripAdvisor og således blandt verdens bedste procent af restauranter. Succesen er primært vægtet på køkkenet - og forstærket af et kompetent tjenerstab. Et meget stærkt team for teamets skyld - ikke for en stjernekok.

Køkkenchef Sandra Larsen dyrker en meget inkluderende kultur, hvor alle hjælper alle og ingen er vigtigere end andre. ONE TEN kalder det for "omvendt hierarki", hvor dem med mest erfaring hjælper dem med mindre erfaring. Tonen er effektiv under service, familiær under prep og nysgerrig under menuudvikling. Personlighed og kemi er således vigtigere end kandidaternes lange cv'er - men uden de rette kompetencer, faglige stolthed og passion for at levere det bedste produkt i teamets navn hver evig eneste gang er stillingerne ikke interessante.

Vi søger en kandidat med god erfaring, kompetent erfaring og passion for at videreudvikle egne personlige kompetencer. ONE TEN er ikke et sted blot for jobbets skyld - det er et sted for kandidater, der måske har en drøm om selv ville drive restaurant en dag og være med på den spændende rejse ONE TEN Providence er på. Måske vil kandidaterne blot føle at være en del af et ekstremt succesfuldt team, der mod alle odds har klaret sig gennem alle udfordringer.

Stillingen er fuldtids a la carte kok. Lønnen aftales efter kompetencer og driftens behov. Dette er ikke en lederstilling, men i stedet en stilling, der på sigt kan give en god frihed til personlig udvikling og indblik i en speciel gren af branchen.

Vi får typisk rigtig mange ansøgninger og kun en lille procentdel kaldes til samtaler. Vi anbefaler derfor kun meget seriøse kandidater søge.

Glæder os meget til at møde jer...

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Consultants, Japan
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise Segment, Japan to lead Notion's Enterprise GTM motion in Japan as we evolve how we sell, build, and deliver outcomes for our largest customers. This is a senior second-line leadership role, leading leaders and teams across the Enterprise segment, with accountability for new logo acquisition, expansion, renewals, and the quality of execution that produces durable customer outcomes.

This person will play an integral role in scaling Notion's evolving GTM motion in Japan. You'll help define what great looks like for the Enterprise segment: how teams identify the right accounts, create urgency with executives, diagnose workflows, run compelling first and second meetings, deliver live builds and value narratives, and hand customers off into adoption with clarity. This is not a traditional pipeline-management role. The best leaders in this motion are coaches first: they can inspect the quality of a customer conversation, watch a live build or deal review, and tell a manager or IC exactly what to change.

As part of the Japan GTM leadership team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our Enterprise sales motion, meaningfully shape our product and customer strategy, and drive revenue growth while building a high-performing team. We need someone with an entrepreneurial and builder spirit, strong enterprise operating discipline, and experience leading through managers. This person should enjoy coaching leaders and reps to be the best they can be, be data-driven, and be experienced in managing complex, high-velocity Enterprise pipeline across new business, expansion, and renewal motions.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead the Japan Enterprise Segment strategy, including territory design, account prioritization, pipeline generation, executive engagement, expansion strategy, renewal health, and long-term revenue growth

 - Lead and develop first-line leaders and senior ICs across the Enterprise motion, raising the bar on coaching quality, operating cadence, performance management, and team execution

 - Own the commercial performance of the Enterprise segment across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, renewals, and UBP outcomes, accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Scale the evolved GTM motion in-market, including account strategy, workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture, live builds in Notion, value narratives, mutual action plans, and adoption hand-offs

 - Build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence for the segment, including weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, forecast calls, and leadership reporting

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects (Sales and Customer Success), BDR, Partnerships, Marketing, Deal Desk, Ops, Legal, and Product to build playbooks and define how Notion wins with Enterprise customers in Japan

 - Partner with BDR leadership on Enterprise pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, qualification standards, and messaging so the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Solutions Consultant and Outcomes Architect leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy, owning the overall commercial arc while collaborating on execution after close

 - Represent Japan Enterprise customer and team signal in regional and global leadership forums, clearly identifying what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Attract, hire, onboard, certify, and retain a world-class Enterprise organization, building a culture of high performance, coaching, accountability, and collaboration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 10+ years of B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or workflow technology experience, with a proven track record of winning and growing Enterprise customers

 - 3+ years of second-line leadership experience, with experience leading managers or multiple teams through a defined operating cadence, performance management, and talent development rhythm

 - Strong understanding of PLG and SLG sales motions, with successful experience combining bottom-up adoption with top-down executive selling in Enterprise accounts

 - Proven ability to scale a GTM transformation or new sales motion, including enablement, inspection, manager coaching, playbook adoption, and consistent execution across teams

 - Strong enterprise customer instincts, with the ability to guide teams through complex discovery, multi-stakeholder evaluation, technical validation, business case creation, and adoption planning

 - Deep coaching orientation: you can inspect a deal review, customer call, or live build and identify specifically what needs to change, not just whether the outcome was good

 - Strong analytical judgment, able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, use customer and team signal to build strategy, and drive urgency without micromanaging

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Deal Desk

 - A builder mentality who thrives in collaborative environments, operates well in ambiguity, and creates structure, playbooks, and operating rhythms where they do not yet exist

 - Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior customer stakeholders and represent Japan Enterprise priorities to regional and global leadership

 - Fluency in Japanese (native or bilingual level) and English (high-business level)

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and deliver stronger customer outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading Enterprise GTM in Japan or across APAC for a high-growth SaaS or AI company

 - Experience leading through a major GTM organizational change, sales methodology rollout, segment redesign, or role redesign across Enterprise teams

 - Experience selling or leading teams in a consumption, usage-based, or adoption-led business where customer outcomes matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage, including hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Strong technical fluency or experience working closely with technical sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, or partner teams

 - Experience selling through or partnering with systems integrators, channel partners, or strategic alliances in Japan

 - Experience with quarterly or annual sales planning, territory planning, and Enterprise capacity planning




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist, Virta, Helsinki
jobs.description:
About the role

Virta is a pioneer in the electric vehicle charging business, enabling charging at over 500,000 stations in more than 60 countries.

As a Technical Support Specialist, you will support customers with diverse technical questions related to EV charging products and services. You will work closely with B2B and B2C customers as well as internal product, sales, and technical teams, constantly improving the customer experience in the rapidly growing e-mobility industry.

This role is an excellent fit for a customer service or IT professional who already has technical experience, for example, from Contact Center work, ticketing, and multi-channel, multilingual communication. You understand the nature of technical support work and want to grow in one of the world's fastest-developing industries.

The team currently includes two colleagues in Sweden, and we are now looking for the first specialist for this role in Finland! You will work closely with professionals in both the Finnish and Swedish offices, which is why we expect you to have fluent Swedish skills in addition to Finnish and English.

Why Virta?
- Significance: You get to do work that has a real impact on sustainability, energy systems, and customer experience.
- Work Environment: You will work with industry-leading technology as part of a passionate, international team.
- Flexibility: A full-time (37.5 h/week) permanent contract with a flexible hybrid model. You can work 3 days a week remotely and 2 days at the office in Ruoholahti, Helsinki (Energiakatu 4).

Work tasks
- Customer Interface: Responding to customer inquiries in a timely and accurate manner. Communication is mainly written (Zendesk, Jira, Confluence, Slack, email) and occasionally via phone. Your working languages will be Swedish, English, and Finnish.
- Problem Solving: 2nd line technical support troubleshooting using a ticketing system. You will gather relevant information, analyze root causes, and propose corrective actions.
- Documentation: Recording and updating technical issues and customer interactions for knowledge sharing and internal training.
- Escalation: Moving more complex cases forward to the correct parties, ensuring all necessary background information is included.
- Coordination and development work: Resolving fault situations together with other teams. You will also participate in customer meetings to review feedback and recurring problems.

We are looking for

- Language Skills: Excellent oral and written skills in Finnish, Swedish, and English.
- Customer Support Experience: You have handled written customer service tasks within the desired service levels. Experience in providing customer service by phone is also considered an advantage.
- Technical Understanding: You are comfortable with PC systems, ticketing, and CRM/ERP tools (e.g., Zendesk). You should also feel comfortable running scripts, although actual software development expertise is not required. Previous experience in similar technical support roles or Contact Center experience is considered an advantage.
- Work Ethic: You are systematic, precise, and proactive. You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
- Education and Additional Skills: A Bachelors degree (University of Applied Sciences/University, e.g., Business, IT, Logistics). Previous experience with SQL queries or ITIL knowledge is considered a plus.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

N3 CVRT LTD (formerly Blanchardstown Commercials) is a long-established, family-run commercial vehicle testing and repair centre operating since 2012. Based at Unit 4 Damastown Close, Damastown Industrial Park, Dublin 15, D15 N8KP, Ireland, We wish to recruit 5 HGV/LCV Mechanics we provide high-quality servicing, repairs, and testing for all makes and models of commercial and private vehicles including trucks, trailers, vans, and cars. Applicants must have a minimum of 5 years experience within a similar position, excellent communication skills are required. Annual Salary:€40,000.00 working hours: 39 per week Key Responsibilities Carry out servicing, maintenance, and mechanical repairs on HGVs, LCVs, and other commercial vehicles Perform vehicle inspections and diagnostic fault finding Complete work efficiently and accurately in line with job cards Report service and repair updates to the Workshop Manager Maintain a clean, safe, and organised workspace Follow all company safety procedures and policies Requirements Fully qualified HGV and/or LCV Motor Mechanic Strong experience in vehicle servicing, maintenance, and diagnostics Good knowledge of CVRT requirements and commercial vehicle regulations Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced workshop environment Full valid driving licence (Truck licence advantageous but not essential for LCV candidates) Good computer literacy Strong work ethic with reliable time management skills

jobs.title: Vil du være med å sikre varme på byggeplasser over hele Østlandet? Renta søker montasjeleder på midlertidig byggvarme.
jobs.description:
Vi søker en praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert montør til vår avdeling på Gardermoen.
Du vil ha en viktig rolle i å etablere og drifte varme- og tørkeløsninger for kunder innen bygg og anlegg.

Arbeidsområdet vil i hovedsak være Østlandet og stillingen innebærer variert arbeid ute hos kunder og vedlikehold inne på arbeidsplassen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

· Montering og demontering av midlertidige varmeanlegg

· Oppkobling av slanger, fordelingsutstyr og tilhørende komponenter

· Transport og klargjøring av utstyr

· Service, vedlikehold og feilsøking på utstyr

· Oppfølging av kunder ute på byggeplass

· Bidra til orden og struktur på avdelingen

Vi ser etter deg som

· Har praktisk erfaring fra bygg, anlegg, VVS, industri eller tekniske fag

· Er selvstendig og løsningsorientert

· Trives med fysisk arbeid og varierte arbeidsdager

· Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhet og kundeservice

· Behersker norsk muntlig og skriftlig

· Har førerkort klasse BE

Det er en fordel om du har

· Erfaring med varmeanlegg, VVS eller tekniske installasjoner

· Maskinførerbevis eller truckførerbevis

· Erfaring fra byggeplass eller entreprenørvirksomhet

 

Vi tilbyr

· En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag

· Moderne utstyr og gode arbeidsforhold

· Konkurransedyktige betingelser

· God opplæring og faglig utvikling

· Et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

· Mulighet til å bli en del av et selskap i sterk vekst

Arbeidssted: Renta Gardermoen

Arbeidsområde: Østlandet

 

Søknader vurderes fortløpende.

Interessert? Ta gjerne kontakt for en uforpliktende prat.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Renta AS ble etablert som selskap i Norge i 2018, da det finske morselskapet Renta Oy kjøpte vestlandsfirmaet Flexleie (50 ansatte og 120 mill. i omsetning). I 2021 kom nordnorske Byggesystemer med på laget (180 ansatte og 285 mill. i omsetning). I april i 2022 ble østlandsaktøren Utleiesenteret kjøpt opp (80 ansatte og 305 mill.). I 2023 ble Høyde-Service Utleie og Mylift Gruppen kjøpt og er dermed også en del av Renta. Renta AS er nå blant de største selskapene innen utleie av maskiner, stillas og øvrig utstyr til bygg- og anleggsbransjen. Vi er nå 600 ansatte fordelt på 32 avdelinger.

jobs.title: Siivooja
jobs.description:
Etsimme reipasta, huolellista ja oma-aloitteista työntekijää määräaikaiseen siivoustehtävään. Työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi ylioppilaalle, joka viettää välivuottaan ja suunnittelee hakevansa jatko-opintoihin keväällä.

Työ koostuu pääasiassa Airbnb- ja muiden lyhytaikaisasuntojen siivouksesta sekä liinavaatteiden vaihdosta. Osa työpäivistä sisältää myös muiden kiinteistöjen toimistosiivousta. Työ on itsenäistä ja siinä korostuvat tarkkuus, tunnollisuus sekä hyvä työnjälki.

Tarjoamme:

- Palkka 930 €/kk

- Osa-aikatyö

- Päivätyö maanantaista perjantaihin

- Itsenäinen ja vastuullinen työ

- Mukavan ja joustavan työympäristön


Odotamme sinulta:

- Tarkkaa ja huolellista työotetta

- Sujuvaa suomenkielen taitoa

- Tunnollisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- Halua pitää kohteet siisteinä ja viihtyisinä asiakkaille


Työsuhde alkaa 24.8. ja kestää sopimuksen mukaan 3–6 kuukautta.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen info(at)vanajaliving.fi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi sekä mahdollisesta aiemmasta kokemuksestasi siivousalalta. Lisätietoja numerosta 045 1144224.
