jobs.title: Directeur Adjoint d'Hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Notre client, groupe en forte croissance sur le marché du coliving, nous mandate pour le recrutement d'un(e) Directeur Adjoint de Résidence (F/H) sur Toulouse.


Au sein d'une résidence de nouvelle génération alliant logements, espaces partagés et services, vous intervenez sur des sujets commerciaux, opérationnels et administratifs liés au fonctionnement général du site. Positionné(e) comme le bras droit de la Direction, vos principales missions sont les suivantes Participer à la commercialisation de la résidence : visites, relances, rédaction et signature des contrats, suivi des arrivées et des départs Contribuer à la mise en place de la politique commerciale et marketing du site (animation des réseaux sociaux, partenariats locaux avec les entreprises, écoles et acteurs du territoire Assurer le suivi quotidien des réservations de court séjour et long séjour en accompagnant l'équipe de réception Coordonner l'activité quotidienne des équipes et des prestataires externes (maintenance, entretien, intervenants événementiels Participer à l'animation de la vie du site : organisation d'évènements, développement de la communauté de résidents, suivi de la satisfaction Définir avec la direction les KPI's spécifiques au co-living et aider au clôtures mensuelles Veiller au respect des procédures et des critères de qualité, d'hygiène et de sécurité Assurer le remplacement du Directeur en cas d'absence Description du profil :

Issu(e) d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'au moins deux ans d'expérience dans le domaine de l'hôtellerie, de l'hébergement ou de l'exploitation de résidences.


Reconnu(e) pour votre relationnel et votre sens du service, vous êtes à l'aise aussi bien dans la relation client et la vente que dans le suivi administratif. Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous savez prioriser les urgences et gérer les imprévus du quotidien d'un site en exploitation.


La résidence accueillant une clientèle internationale, la maîtrise de l'anglais est exigée pour le poste.


Vous rejoignez un groupe dont le réseau de résidences s'étoffe chaque année, et où les parcours d'évolution interne (vers des fonctions de direction de site ou des périmètres élargis) sont une réalité.


Processus de recrutement : Pré-sélection sur CV > Echange téléphonique > Entretien EOSIUM > Références > Entretiens Client. Une prise de références professionnelles sera réalisée, avec votre accord, : elle permettra d'attester la rigueur et le sérieux dont vous avez fait preuve dans de précédentes fonctions.

jobs.title: Store Manager - dubbu
jobs.description:
About the job

dubbu is expanding in Copenhagen, and we are looking for a Store Manager (37 hours/week) to lead our upcoming store — a new version of a familiar location, now including a small serving area inspired by Korean café culture.

As Store Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, the team, and ensuring that both the retail space and the serving area run smoothly every day.

You will work closely with the founder team and have significant influence on how the store develops in the coming years.

Your responsibilities

Leadership & team

  • Daily leadership of the team (scheduling, onboarding, training, and feedback)

  • Ensuring a high standard of customer service and sales

  • Coaching the team to improve performance on the sales floor

Store operations

  • Overseeing daily operations (opening/closing, stock deliveries, inventory, routines)

  • Ensuring the store always appears well-organized and ready for customers

  • Working with simple KPIs (sales, conversion rate, AOV)

Serving area

  • Responsible for the operation of the store’s small café area

  • Ensuring consistent quality and service speed

  • Daily cleaning, hygiene, and maintenance of equipment

  • Training staff in workflow and standards

  • Contributing to the development of new drinks inspired by Korean café culture

We are looking for someone who

  • Has 2–3 years of experience in retail or café environments, preferably with operational responsibility

  • Is structured and comfortable working with routines, checklists, and clear standards

  • Can lead a team and maintain calm and overview in a busy environment

  • Is hands-on and takes ownership of both people and operations

  • Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of a well-executed customer experience

It is a plus if you

  • Have experience with barista work, matcha, or espresso

  • Have worked with food hygiene or basic food safety procedures

  • Have experience with merchandising or retail visuals

  • Have an interest in Korean culture, cafés, or beauty

What we offer

  • A central role in a growing company

  • Close collaboration with the founder team

  • Significant influence on the store’s development

  • A strong team and an ambitious brand universe

  • Staff discount across our entire product range

Application

Start date: as soon as possible

Please send your CV and a short application to:

job@dubbu.dk

Subject line: “Store Manager”

jobs.description:
Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team
Luxembourg
Line of Service Tax
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets

Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

In tax reporting strategy at PwC, you will assist clients in developing tax reporting strategies and maintaining compliance with tax regulations. In this field, you will analyse financial data, interpret tax laws, and provide guidance on tax reporting requirements, aiming to optimise tax positions and minimise risks for businesses.

Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior in Operational tax team (m/f/d). What if it was you?

We are the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg, providing audit, tax and advisory services to a wide variety of clients. To make it happen, we count on the expertise of over 3,600 people from more than 90 different countries, who strive every day to reach excellence and team up to solve important problems through innovative solutions. We value diverse and singular career paths, embrace everyone's unique self and encourage our People to fuel their potential in a work environment that is inclusive, stimulating, and motivating.  
Our Operational Tax department is growing and we are looking for a motivated professional eager to take on real responsibility in a dynamic and international environment. As a Senior Associate within our FATCA/CRS dedicated team, you will be a trusted advisor to financial institutions navigating complex regulatory landscapes — from private equity and real estate to banking and asset management.

Your mission:

Your role sits at the intersection of tax, operations, and compliance. Concretely, you will:
Advise and support clients on their FATCA, CRS, QI and DAC6 obligations - from entity classification and investor on-boarding to due diligence and annual reporting. You will be their go-to contact for technical questions, guiding them through regulatory requirements with clarity and confidence.
Review and validate a wide range of client documentation - self-certification forms, U.S. withholding certificates, account opening forms, master files, and XML FATCA/CRS reports - ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable legislation.
Drive quality and oversight by preparing gap analyses, controls reports and sign-off reports, QI  and DAC6 reports, monitoring regulatory update impacting our clients and consulting and reporting services.
Contribute to projects and initiatives that shape how the team operates - from building and refining internal processes and methodologies to exploring how to bring more efficiency and intelligence to compliance work.  
Collaborate and grow in close cooperation with colleagues across the Operational Tax department and beyond. You will contribute to tailored client solutions, support junior team members, and benefit from a training programme that you can shape according to your own development goals.

Let's talk about you

You will thrive in this role if you:

• Hold a Master's degree in Tax, Law, Economics, Business Administration or a related field;
• Bring at least 3 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in the financial services industry;
• Have solid knowledge of FATCA, CRS and/or QI legislation;
• Are comfortable working with data — databases, structured reports, and XML environments;
• Are a strong communicator who enjoys daily client interactions and can explain complex topics with clarity;
• Have a proactive mindset and a genuine interest in process improvement, project work, and new technologies including AI;
• Are fluent in English and French - any additional language is a plus.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: Relationship Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.


What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.

        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

jobs.title: ASISTENT/ICA U PRODAJI I PRETPRODAJI
jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • istraživati tržište i pronalaziti građevinske tvrtke koje odgovaraju našoj ciljanoj skupini
  • sastavljati i redovito ažurirati popise potencijalnih korisnika
  • pronalaziti vlasnike, direktore i druge osobe odgovorne za donošenje odluka
  • istraživati osnovne podatke o tvrtki prije prvog kontakta
  • kontaktirati potencijalne korisnike putem e-maila i telefona
  • predstaviti razlog javljanja i provjeriti postoji li interes za razgovor
  • voditi komunikaciju od prvog kontakta do dogovaranja prodajne prezentacije
  • zakazivati termine i pripremati prodaji informacije o potencijalnom korisniku
  • voditi urednu evidenciju svih kontakata i aktivnosti u HubSpotu
  • pratiti dogovorene rokove i planirati ponovne kontakte
  • pripremati i slati ponude, ugovore i fakture prema postojećim predlošcima
  • surađivati s prodajom i osobom zaduženom za odnose s korisnicima
  • na početku ćete upoznati Insidico, postojeće korisnike i probleme koje aplikacija rješava
  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji
  • prve popise kontakata, e-mailove i pozive prolazit ćemo zajedno. Cilj je da nakon razdoblja uhodavanja možete samostalno organizirati svoj rad i voditi pretprodajne aktivnosti
  • opseg aktivnosti i očekivani rezultati prilagođavat će se dogovorenom broju radnih sati
Poslodavac traži:
  • tražimo osobu koja zna jasno komunicirati, dobro organizirati svoj rad i samostalno doći do potrebnih informacija
  • važno nam je da nemate problem nazvati osobu s kojom prethodno niste razgovarali.U ovom poslu bit će neodgovorenih e-mailova, odbijenih poziva i odgovora da tvrtka trenutačno nije zainteresirana. Očekujemo da takve situacije prihvatite kao normalan dio prodajnog procesa i nastavite raditi bez nepotrebnog pritiska na potencijalnog korisnika.
  • prethodno iskustvo u prodaji nije uvjet. Spremni smo raditi i s osobom koja tek ulazi u prodaju, ali očekujemo interes za učenje, samostalnost i odgovornost prema dogovorenim zadacima.
Uvjeti:
  • najmanje završena srednja škola
  • razvijene usmene i pisane komunikacijske vještine
  • organiziranost i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • samostalnost, upornost i snalažljivost
  • urednost u vođenju podataka i praćenju rokova
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • korištenje programa Microsoft Office i Outlook
  • spremnost na rad u HubSpotu, Google kalendaru, Google Meetu i internim alatima
  • aktivno znanje hrvatskog jezika
  • B2B prodaji ili telefonskom kontaktiranju potencijalnih korisnika
  • istraživanju tržišta i izradi baza kontakata
  • radu u CRM sustavu, posebno HubSpotu
  • građevinskoj industriji
  • prodaji softvera ili drugih poslovnih usluga
Poslodavac nudi:
  • rad na nepuno radno vrijeme uz mogućnost kasnijeg prelaska na puno radno vrijeme
  • mogućnost rada putem ugovora o radu ili studentskog ugovora
  • fleksibilan raspored unutar unaprijed dogovorenog broja sati
  • rad iz našeg ureda u Osijeku
  • mogućnost djelomičnog rada od kuće nakon razdoblja uhodavanja
  • dogovoreni sustav nagrađivanja prema rezultatima
  • rad u malom timu u kojem ćete izravno surađivati s prodajom i Customer Successom
  • detaljan onboarding i podršku tijekom prvih mjeseci
  • mogućnost napredovanja prema samostalnom vođenju prodajnih prezentacija i prodajnih procesa
Postupak odabira: Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor bit će pozvani na razgovor i praktično testiranje. Testiranje će uključivati zadatke povezane s istraživanjem potencijalnih korisnika, pisanom komunikacijom, organizacijom rada i kratkom simulacijom telefonskog razgovora. Ne očekujemo da prije razgovora poznajete sve funkcionalnosti Insidica. Zanima nas kako razmišljate, pronalazite informacije, komunicirate i organizirate zadatke. Prijava Pošaljite životopis na matej@insidico.com najkasnije do 01. rujna 2026. Planirani početak rada je tijekom rujna 2026., prema dogovoru s odabranim kandidatom.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we structure our product teams https://www.youtube.com/watch?index=59&list=PLXDU_eVOJTx402DljIPagaDKLibF-qfF0&v=I4vvBidQcck talk by our Head of Product, Nan Yu, at Config 2024

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

jobs.description:
**Tehtävän kuvaus**

Haemme North Resort Oy:lle siivoojaa (Housekeeper / Cleaner) huolehtimaan kansainvälisen matkailukeskuksen majoitus-, sauna- ja yleisten tilojen puhtaudesta sekä viihtyisyydestä. Tehtävässä olet tärkeässä roolissa laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen varmistamisessa.

**Keskeiset työtehtävät**

- Majoitustilojen siivous, lähtö- sekä ylläpitosiivoukset.

- Ohjelmapalvelutilojen, saunojen ja yleisten tilojen siivous.

- Liinavaatehuolto sekä tekstiilien käsittely.

- Siivousvälineiden ja -tarvikkeiden asianmukainen käyttö ja huolto.

- Siisteyden ja laadun jatkuva valvonta.

- Tarvittaessa muut kiinteistön ylläpitoa tukevat tehtävät.


**Odotamme hakijalta**

- Kokemusta siivous- tai majoitusalan tehtävistä tai soveltuvaa koulutusta.

- Huolellisuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja hyvää fyysistä työkykyä.

- Hyvää palveluasennetta ja yhteistyötaitoja.

- Perustason englannin kielen taitoa; muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

jobs.title: Part-time Tea House Assistant
jobs.description:
We're looking for a part-time Tea House Assistant.

You'll be working directly with the owner in a small independent tea house. This is a hands-on role where you'll be involved in every part of the daily operation. There isn't a separate person for each task, so everyone helps wherever needed.

Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities may include:

- Preparing and serving tea using Gongfu brewing methods

- Introducing our teas and sharing basic tea knowledge with customers

- Helping customers choose teas and tea products

- Preparing tea drinks and desserts

- Operating the cashier and processing payments

- Handling takeaway and delivery orders independently

- Packing loose-leaf tea for retail sales

- Restocking products and organising inventory

- Washing dishes and maintaining a clean workspace

- Cleaning the shop

- Supporting other day-to-day operational tasks as needed


During busy periods, you'll often be serving customers, preparing drinks, handling takeaway and delivery orders, and managing multiple tasks at the same time. During quieter periods, you'll help with packing tea, restocking, cleaning, organising, and preparing the shop for the next rush.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:

- Friendly, reliable, and responsible

- Comfortable talking with customers

- Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

- Comfortable multitasking and adapting to different responsibilities

- Proactive and able to work independently

- Interested in learning about tea and providing excellent customer service


Language requirements

- Fluent Finnish

- Good English

- Basic Chinese listening skills are a plus, but not required


Position

- Part-time

- Weekend and evening availability is preferred

- Full training will be provided


Before you apply

This is an independent tea house, not a large chain with separate roles for each employee. You'll be working directly with the owner, and the role requires flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to manage different responsibilities throughout the day. If you're looking for a position with only one fixed responsibility or prefer a slower-paced working environment, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.

If this sounds like the kind of work you enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a short introduction to \[info@teetao.fi\].

As we're a small independent business, we're unfortunately unable to reply to every application individually. If your experience matches what we're looking for, we'll contact you within **two business days** to arrange the next step.

If you don't hear from us within two business days, it means we've decided to move forward with other applicants. We sincerely appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.

Description de l'entreprise
Le Groupe BPCE, avec son modèle de banque coopérative universelle, représenté par 9 millions de sociétaires, est le deuxième acteur bancaire en France. Avec 105 000 collaborateurs, il est au service de 30 millions de clients dans le monde, particuliers, professionnels, entreprises, investisseurs et collectivités locales. Il est présent dans la banque de proximité et l'assurance en France avec ses deux grands réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d'Epargne ainsi que la Banque Palatine. Chez BPCE Equipment Solutions, nous sommes spécialisés en financement des ventes et des équipements professionnels aux entreprises et nous sommes leader en Europe et n°2 mondial sur notre marché. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis à l'international nous sommes régulièrement primés notamment aux Leasing Life Awards en tant que "SME Champion of the year" et / ou « European Lessor of the year ». Entité à taille humaine, agile et innovante, rejoignez-nous pour partager notre Vision : "We want to be a leading provider of innovative and flexible solutions to finance and manage equipment. We are a digital and customer-centric organization, committed to deliver an excellent experience to vendors partners and clients across countries. We are a great place to work, driven by simplicity, agility and sustainability."
Poste et missions
Vous rejoignez l'équipe de Vincent, composée de 22 personnes en tant que Business Analyst Senior.Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data en place au sein de BPCE ES, répartie entre Paris et Bangalore. Cette équipe a en charge la gestion de la plateforme Data utilisée pour le pilotage commercial, financier, risque et Conformité de BPCE ES. Elle est aussi porteuse des principes Data à appliquer dans les projets de la Business Unit, sur la Data Quality ou la Protection des données.Dans cette équipe, vous aurez notamment l'occasion de contribuer au programme d'intégration de BPCE ES dans le Groupe BPCE, ainsi qu'au support des sujets transverses de la filière Data.Au quotidien, vous avez pour missions de :Recueillir les besoins auprès des Métiers, spécifications et validation des développements de la plateforme Data & Reporting réalisés dans l'équipe Accompagner les entités de la BU sur les évolutions de la plateforme Data et de la filière DataSupporter l'équipe dans les activités de Data Management, notamment le pilotage des usages DataContribuer aux pratiques agiles de l'équipe (slicing, priorisation par la valeur.) et accompagner le métier dans la transformation agileVous aurez l'occasion de partager de votre expérience au sein d'un environnement multiculturel (collaborateurs à Bangalore) et très en lien avec les Métiers et leurs problématiques. Un processus de recrutement efficace : une fois votre CV présélectionné, préparez-vous à un entretien RH avec un Responsable Recrutement, suivi de deux entretiens métiers maximum. A Note from the Founder

Why Sticky is Free to Use

Hey â I'm Hamza Saleem, the solo developer behind Sticky.today.

In May 2026, I made a decision most SaaS founders won't make: I fired our payment processor and made Sticky completely free for everyone.

Here's why.

Software Should Be Free

Sticky started as a paid product. Pro plans, trials, subscriptions â the usual SaaS playbook. And it worked. People paid. But something felt off.

The best tools I've ever used didn't ask for my credit card. They just worked. Obsidian, VS Code, Blender â tools that respected me enough to not put a gate between me and my work. I wanted Sticky to be that kind of tool.

So I tore out every line of billing code. No more trials. No more upgrade prompts. No more payment gateways. Just a fast, free canvas for your ideas.

The Internet Has Enough Gatekeepers

Look around â every productivity tool wants $10-20/month from you. Per seat. Per feature. It adds up. And for what? Most of them are glorified text editors with a subscription attached.

Sticky is different. It's a spatial thinking tool built by one person who actually uses it every day. There's no board of investors demanding recurring revenue. There's no pressure to add "enterprise features" nobody asked for. There's just me, building software I believe in, and you, using it however you want.

I don't think thinking should cost money. Your brain doesn't charge you rent. Neither should your canvas.

What You Get (For Free)

Unlimited Boards

Create as many canvases as you need. No caps, no limits.

Real-Time Collaboration

Share boards and work together with live cursors.

AI Idea Generator

Brainstorm with GPT-4o-mini. 10 free generations per day.

Self-Hosting

MIT licensed. Run it on your own infrastructure.

Dynamic Tables

Insert editable tables alongside your sticky notes.

Dark Mode

Easy on the eyes. Built in from day one.

What's Next?

Sticky will keep improving. I'm building it in public â follow along on Twitter/X or check out the source code on GitHub. No investors. No roadmap dictated by revenue targets. Just a guy building software he believes in, for people who actually want to use it.

If you read this far, thanks. If Sticky helps you think, that's the win.

Follow on X View on GitHub

jobs.title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
jobs.description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.

jobs.title: Mechanical Testing Engineer (Hands-On Role)
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Step into a hands-on role where you drive the future of materials reliability and safety. Join our dynamic team of 15 dedicated materials professionals and take the lead in planning and executing advanced mechanical and thermo-mechanical tests. You’ll collaborate closely with R&D and engineering teams, ensuring our test rigs and equipment are always ready for the next challenge. Imagine yourself evaluating test results with precision, supporting structural safety work, and making a real impact on the performance of critical components. If you’re passionate about innovation and eager to grow in a diverse, inclusive environment, this is your opportunity to shine.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    You perform advanced mechanical and thermo-mechanical tests, including Thermo-Mechanical Fatigue (TMF), Tensile, Impact, and Low Cycle Fatigue (LCF) testing.
    You evaluate and interpret test results, delivering clear and accurate insights.
    You plan and coordinate testing activities in partnership with R&D and engineering teams.
    You support and organize maintenance of mechanical test rigs and related equipment.
    You contribute to structural safety work, including risk assessments and integrity evaluations, and follow up with metallographic analysis when needed.

What You Bring

    You hold a Master’s degree (MSc) in Materials Technology or a closely related field, with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
    You have hands-on expertise with mechanical testing equipment and procedures, and are familiar with TMF, LCF, and metallographic techniques.
    You demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
    You are fluent in English; Swedish language skills are a plus.
    You bring experience with MATLAB and Python for data analysis, and proficiency in Microsoft Office for documentation and reporting.

About the Team

You’ll join a collaborative and inclusive group of 15 materials technicians, engineers, and experts who are passionate about advancing materials and structural integrity. Our team thrives on diversity, drawing strength from a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We work closely together to deliver high-impact projects, support each other’s growth, and maintain a stimulating environment with cutting-edge testing capabilities. Inclusion and belonging are at the heart of our culture, and we believe that every voice matters.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

jobs.title: Inhoppare till hemvården i Ekenäs
jobs.description:
Vill du möjliggöra ett gott liv för de äldre? Vill du vara en del av ett mångprofessionellt team? Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss på Folkhälsan inom äldreomsorgen i Raseborg!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab söker inhoppare till hemvården i Ekenäs

Vi söker dig som studerar eller redan har utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen.

Inom hemvården ger vi stöd att bo kvar hemma och leva ett självständigt liv. Vi hjälper till med dagliga sysslor, personlig omvårdnad, socialt stöd eller vård i hemmet. Arbetet är självständigt och du jobbar i två skift, arbetstiderna är mellan kl.7.00-21.00. Arbetet sker främst i de två olika Folkhälsan husen samt i närheten av dem i Ekenäs. Ett godkänt läkemedelslov och hygienpass är nödvändigt.

Arbetet kräver följande behörigheter:

- För närvårdare krävs en närvårdarexamen eller motsvarande tidigare examen, såsom hjälpskötare eller primärskötare, med registrering i Valvira. Vi förutsätter att du som närvårdare också har ett godkänt läkemedelslov.
- Vi tar gärna även emot studeranden inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen med minst 60 studiepoäng.
- Vårt arbetsspråk är svenska och vi förutsätter goda kunskaper både i tal och skrift, man bör även behärska finska i tal.

Som inhoppare på Folkhälsan får du ett brett nätverk och värdefull arbetserfarenhet. Det går utmärkt att kombinera inhopparjobbet med studier eller annat deltidsjobb. Blev du nyfiken? Då kan du läsa mera här:

jobs.title: Säljare
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu svensktalande säljare till vårt kontor i Málaga.

Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill utvecklas inom försäljning, arbeta i en internationell miljö och samtidigt få uppleva livet i Spanien tillsammans med ett ambitiöst team.

Hos oss arbetar du med investeringsrelaterade tjänster och har daglig kontakt med både kunder som redan visat intresse och nya potentiella kunder. Rollen passar dig som är driven, social och motiveras av att utvecklas både professionellt och ekonomiskt.

Du behöver inte vara en färdig toppsäljare från dag ett — det viktigaste är att du har rätt inställning, disciplin och viljan att bli riktigt bra på det du gör.

Vi erbjuder en strukturerad arbetsmiljö med tydliga mål, coaching och goda möjligheter att påverka både din utveckling och din inkomst.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Kontakta och följa upp både varma och kalla kunder
    Presentera bolagets tjänster på ett tydligt och professionellt sätt
    Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer
    Arbeta mot individuella och gemensamma mål
    Utvecklas löpande genom coaching och feedback

Vi söker dig som

    Talar flytande svenska i tal och skrift
    Är kommunikativ och trygg i telefon
    Har stark arbetsmoral och vill utvecklas
    Motiveras av mål, prestation och personlig utveckling
    Trivs i en miljö med tempo och ansvar
    Har tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning (meriterande men inget krav)
    Har svenskt eller europeiskt pass

Vi erbjuder

    Fast lön från 1 800 € per månad
    Provision och bonus utan lönetak
    Kontinuerlig coaching och utbildning
    Modernt kontor i centrala Málaga
    Internationell arbetsmiljö med stark teamkänsla
    Möjlighet till hjälp med flytt och etablering
    Tydliga utvecklingsmöjligheter för rätt person

Arbetet sker på plats i Málaga måndag till fredag enligt svenska arbetstider — vilket ger struktur i vardagen och friheten att njuta av livet i Spanien på kvällar och helger.

För rätt person kan detta bli starten på en långsiktig karriär inom försäljning och finans.

    Skicka in din ansökan med uppdaterat CV på svenska. Urval sker löpande.

Liikuntaleikkikoulu eli liikkari on monipuolinen liikuntakerho 2-6-vuotiaille tytöille ja pojille. Liikuntaleikkikoulussa lapsi oppii kehon hallintaa, perusliikkeitä ja yhdessäoloa sekä kokee oivaltamisen iloa ja onnistumisen elämyksiä.

- Tuntien suunnittelu ja näiden turvallinen toteuttaminen yhdessä ohjaajaparin kanssa

Seuraamme sopii ohjaajaksi täysi-ikäiset innostavat, positiiviset hakijat, joiden mielenkiinto on lasten liikunnassa. Erityisen tärkeää on myös välittävä asenne ohjauksessa lasten positiivisten liikuntakokemusten varmistamiseksi.

- kokemus lasten liikuntaryhmien ohjaamisesta

jobs.title: Associate in GC & IMM
jobs.employer: HSBC Continental Europe Bank, Sweden Filial
jobs.description:
Business:                         CIB

Location:                            Stockholm, Sweden



Role Purpose

As an Associate in GC & IMM, your main responsibilities will include:

    Supporting one or more Global Relationship Bankers on a defined portfolio of clients within Nordics Banking
    Collaborating with others across GC & IMM in order to manage the clients’ global relationships
    Origination: Identifying marketing opportunities, undertaking appropriate analysis and preparation of proposals, presentations and pitches for new products and services
    Execution: interacting with clients and various product teams in order to ensure smooth execution in a timely manner
    Client engagement: establishing strong relationship with the portfolio of clients
    Financial Analysis: Developing an understanding of clients’ financials in order to assess the capital markets needs and the credit strengths / weaknesses
    Client Materials: Assisting in the preparation of presentations and other materials for clients
    Sector knowledge: Keeping up to date with the markets and the sector developments to support business development, portfolio management and credit risk assessment
    Collaborating with product and country teams
    Portfolio management / HSBC Strategy: understanding GC & IMM internal return hurdles and identifying opportunities to reduce Risk Weighted Assets to enhance relationship returns



Customers / Stakeholders        

Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets - First and foremost, a resource for the Strategic Innovation Investments senior investment professionals.

Portfolio companies – work with our existing and Target client base to develop strategic relevance with HSBC and value-add from HSBC

Internal businesses – work with internal business champions to develop strategic ties to our clients



Leadership & Teamwork

Support achievement of the HSBC vision, Values, goals and culture in personal behaviour, actions and decision making.

Take personal responsibility for understanding and agreeing performance expectations, completing the necessary mandatory training and developing the levels of capability and competence needed to be effective in the role.

Contribute to team development, effectiveness and success by sharing knowledge and good practice, working collaboratively with others to create a productive, diverse and supportive working environment.



Operational Effectiveness & Control

Suggest ideas and contribute to implementing actions that will improve customer service, quality or the way teams and individuals work together.

Adhere to HSBC policy, procedures and control requirements applicable to day-to-day working, exceptional and project activities, and raise any concerns about actual or potential issues promptly, in line with reporting and escalation procedures.

Continuously monitor relevant management information, gather information from Banking sources to assess potential impacts and identify risks, necessary changes and business opportunities.

Apply Banking policies, procedures, practices and standards to their allocated tasks, taking responsibility for their own actions, to ensure the achievement of high levels of quality, effective risk management and regulatory compliance.



Role Context

Management of Risk

The jobholder will ensure the fair treatment of our customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation.

This will be achieved by consistently displaying the behaviours that form part of the HSBC Values and culture and adhering to HSBC risk policies and procedures, including notification and escalation of any concerns and taking required action in relation to points raised by audit and/or external regulators.

The jobholder is responsible for managing and mitigating operational risks in their day to day operations. In executing these responsibilities, the Group has adopted risk management and internal control structure referred to as the ‘Three Lines of Defence’. The jobholder should ensure they understand their position within the Three Lines of Defence, and act accordingly in line with operational risk policy, escalating in a timely manner where they are unsure of actions required.

Through the implementation the Global AML, Sanctions and ABC Policies, supporting Guidance, and Line of Business Procedures the jobholder will make informed decisions in accordance with the core principles of HSBC's Financial Crime Risk Appetite.

The following statement is only for roles with core responsibilities in Operational Risk Management (Risk Owner, Control Owner, Risk Steward, BRCM, and Operational Risk Function

The jobholder has responsibility for overseeing and ensuring that Operational risks are managed in accordance with the Group Standards Manual, Risk FIM, & relevant guidelines & standards. The jobholder should comply with the detailed expectations and responsibilities for their core role in operational risk management through ensuring all actions take account of operational risks, and through using the Operational Risk Management Framework appropriately to manage those risks.

This will be achieved by:

Continuously reassessing risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.

Ensuring all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring, addressing areas of concern in conjunction with Risk and relevant line colleagues, and also by ensuring that actions resulting from points raised by internal or external audits, and external regulators, are correctly implemented in a timely fashion.



Observation of Internal Controls

The jobholder will adhere to, and be able to demonstrate adherence to, internal controls and will implement the Group compliance policy by adhering to all relevant processes/procedures.

The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators.

The following statement is only for roles with managerial or specific Compliance responsibilities

The jobholder will implement measures to contain compliance risk across the business area. This will be achieved by liaising with Compliance department about business initiatives at the earliest opportunity. Also and when applicable, by ensuring adequate resources are in place and training is provided, fostering a compliance culture and optimising relations with regulators.



Candidate requirements:

    Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills
    Ability to undertake in depth review of industry, competitors, clients and products and provide a high quality analysis of credit risk
    Strong financial analysis capability
    Experience in developing marketing materials (pitch books)
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
    Understanding of HSBC Group and products
    High levels of motivation and strong work ethic
    Demonstrated capacity to build a network of contacts, both internal and external, in the context of interactions with colleagues and clients
    A strong understanding of the financial markets
    The position requires a self-confident person who is highly motivated and reliable, with strong team spirit
    Strong negotiation and presentation skills

You'll be part of a highly experienced team with diverse technical backgrounds, creating an environment where you can learn from skilled colleagues, share your own expertise, and grow both professionally and personally. We value collaboration, curiosity, and an open mindset towards new technologies and innovative solutions.

We're looking for someone who brings strong technical expertise, a positive attitude, and a willingness to embrace new technologies and ways of working while contributing to a supportive and collaborative team culture.

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

• Be part of our cross-functional and Agile teams with deep knowledge in the Lending processes, particularly Corporate Lending.

• Participate in identifying customer needs and turning them into functionalities and business capabilities. 

• Define Corporate Lending specific APIs, frameworks and development processes according to best practices.

• Work with developing integrations with multiple source systems.

• Be full-stack, work with FDP development in Kundportalen along with Andromeda APIs and a SQL backend.

• Agree on launch activities together with the team, stakeholders and APO.

• Be a team player and contribute to the team's way of working constantly improving.

• Learn from others and share your skills and experiences in community of practice.

What is needed in this role:

• University degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent

• 10+ years of experience in JAVA development and tools.

• Experience in agile way of working (preferable Scrum, SAFe frameworks).

• Experience in API design, microservices architecture, modular development, component identification and encapsulation of business capability.

• Business domain knowledge within the Corporate Lending area is considered an advantage

• Excellent communication skills and being fluent in English, both spoken and written.

• Demonstrate self-leadership and excellent interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.

become a part of a team that creates ever improving lending journeys for our customers and colleagues. jobs.title: Business Development Representative, MEA
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role will be based in either Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in Arabic.




NICE TO HAVES:

 -  Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
