jobs.title: Assistant Controller, Golf GameBook
jobs.description:
_Golf GameBook is a leading scorecard app with a mission to make golf more fun, easier and simpler for golfers of all levels – on and off the course. Founded in 2007, we set out to modernize golf by replacing traditional paper scorecards with a digital, social experience that brings golfers closer together._

_We believe golf is more than just a game – its about connection, shared moments, and enjoyment both on and off the course. With Golf GameBook, golfers can track live scores, share comments, photos, and videos, and stay connected with their golf community in a fun and effortless way._

_Today, Golf GameBook is used by over 2 million golfers worldwide, with more than 70 million rounds played through the app. As we continue to grow, were always looking for new talent with fresh ideas to help shape the future of golf._

**Would you be our new Assistant Controller?**

As an Assistant Controller, you will join Golf GameBooks finance team in a newly established role created to support our continued growth and international expansion. Working closely with our Head of Finance, you will be involved in a broad range of finance activities and gain a wide understanding of how finance supports a growing international business.

Your responsibilities will include processing sales and purchase invoices, managing daily cash management activities and supporting the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations. Alongside these responsibilities, you will support and develop monthly financial reporting, maintain and develop KPI reporting, and contribute to ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making.

You will also play an active role in developing internal processes and strengthening the internal control environment. As the finance function continues to evolve, you will have the opportunity to participate in reporting development projects and support the implementation of new technologies, including AI-driven solutions.

This is a full-time, permanent position starting as soon as possible. The role is based at our office in Espoo and follows a hybrid working model, with the possibility to work remotely one day per week.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controlling or auditing, together with a relevant educational background (BSc or MSc). You understand how financial processes work in practice and feel comfortable taking ownership of recurring finance tasks while also contributing to the development of reporting, processes and controls. Experience with Netvisor or a similar financial management system, combined with solid Excel skills, will help you succeed in the role.

Fluency in Finnish and English is required, and Swedish language skills are considered a plus. Experience from a technology company, subscription-based business, or another consumer-focused business environment is considered an advantage. Familiarity with BI tools, data analysis and reporting will help you succeed in the role.

As a person, you are detail-oriented, reliable and proactive. You enjoy working in a growth company where you can take ownership of your work and have a genuine impact on how things are done. We believe you will thrive in this role if you are curious by nature, eager to learn and motivated by developing both processes and your own expertise. While you don't need to be a golfer yourself, an interest in the sport or the industry can help you feel right at home in our team.

**Why us?**

At Golf GameBook, you will join a fast-growing company with Finnish roots and an international reach. This role offers a great balance between familiar financial routines and development-oriented work. As Golf GameBook continues to grow, you will have the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility and make a visible impact on how our finance processes and reporting evolve.

You will work closely with the business in a low-hierarchy and agile environment where ideas can quickly turn into action. We value ownership, initiative and a willingness to challenge existing ways of working.

We offer a competitive set of benefits, including two weeks of paid vacation during your first year of employment, extensive healthcare, golf benefits, gym membership, commuter benefits, and more! After your probation period, you can also work remotely from abroad for up to one month per year.

**Are you interested?**

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link no later than 23.8.2026. We will start interviewing candidates during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Nea Repo, Recruitment Consultant, at **nea.repo@biisoni.fi**.

jobs.title: Haemme ravintolatyöntekijöitä Eepeen ABC:n ja Maran henkilöstöpooliin
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Haemme ravintolatyöntekijöitä Eepeen ABC:n ja Maran henkilöstöpooliin
Avoinna olevat ravintolatyöntekijän työtehtävät ovat vakituisia, osa-aikaisin työtunnein, keskimäärin 36-72h/3vko ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.Haemme tekijöitä laajasti poolin eri toimialueille eli rannikon, Suupohjan, Härmänmaan sekä Seinäjoen ja lähikuntien alueille. Mikäli sinua kiinnostaa henkilöstöpoolissa työskentely Eepeen ABC - liikennekaupan ja Maran ravintolamaailma toimipaikoissa hae mukaan!

Henkilöstöpoolissa työskentely on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa – yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen! Pooli on tosi tykätty, joustava ja monipuolinen työskentelymalli, jossa työntekijät pääsevät työskentelemään joustavasti useissa Eepeen toimipaikoissa. Henkilöstöpoolilaisena sinulle kasvaa monipuolinen osaaminen ravintolan työtehtävistä. Poolin tavoitteena on helpottaa yksiköiden arkea, tuoden apua ja osaamista sinne, missä sitä eniten tarvitaan.

Avoinna olevat työtehtävät ABC:n ja maran henkilöstöpoolissa ovat ravintolatyöntekijän työtä. Ravintolatyöntekijät työskentelevät tyypillisesti ravintolamaailmassa tai liikennemyymälässä ja tekevät monipuolisia ravintola-alan tehtäviä, kutenmyynti- ja asiakaspalvelu-, keittiö- ja hesburgerin työtehtäviä. Poolilainen on todellinen arjen moniosaaja ja osaamisen lähettiläs, joka vie hyviä käytäntöjä toimipaikasta toiseen. Hän pääsee auttamaan toimipaikkoja, joilla on äkillinen tarve saada huippu työkaveri avuksi.Poolilaisella on useampi työnteon yksikkö, ja alussa on kattava ja käytännönläheinen perehdytysjakso, jonka aikana ravintolan toimintatavat tulevat tutuiksi. Meillä työskennellään yhdessä tiimin kanssa, joten toivomme sinulta hyviä yhteistyötaitoja. Työ edellyttää oman auton käyttöä ja liikkumista alueen henkilöstöpoolin yksiköissä.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Asumispalvelut, Turku
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Työskentelet lähihoitajana asukaslähtöisesti ja asukkaan toimintakykyä tukien Runosmäen kaupunginosassa sijaitsevassa Villa Piiparin yksikössä. Työsi sisältää asukkaan hoitosuunnitelman mukaista perus- ja lääkehoitoa, toimintakyvyn ja hoidon tarpeen arviointia sekä kulttuuri- ja harrastetoiminnan toteuttamista. Hyödynnät RAI-mittaristoa systemaattisesti asiakkaan toimintakyvyn arvioinnissa ja käytät RAI-tuloksia hoidon suunnittelussa ja arvioinnissa. Laadukas, ajantasainen päivittäiskirjaaminen on keskeinen osa työtäsi.

Toimit itseohjautuvasti, mutta et koskaan yksin, saat vastuun rinnalle työyhteisön tuen. Työhösi kuuluu opiskelijoiden ohjaus sekä päivittäinen omaisyhteistyö. Asukas- ja työturvallisuus ovat meille ensiarvoisen tärkeitä, ja työssä hyödynnetään teknologisia ratkaisuja sekä ergonomisia apuvälineitä. Kunnioitat asukkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja oikeutta hyvään loppuelämään.

Työpaikka sijaitsee osoitteessa Varusmestarintie 14, 20360 Turku, ja meille pääsee helposti julkisilla kulkuneuvoilla.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Saat yksilöllisen perehdytyksen ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuorosuunnitteluun. Arvostamme laaja-alaista osaamista ja tuemme osaamisen kehittämistä organisaatiossamme. Pääset työskentelemään ympärivuorokautisia asumis- ja hoivapalveluja tarjoavassa yksikössä, jossa aito läsnäolo ja asukkaan voimavarojen ylläpitäminen ovat toiminnan ytimessä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa RAI-osaamista ja kykyä hyödyntää sitä toiminnan suunnittelussa ja arvioinnissa sekä ajantasaista päivittäiskirjaamisen taitoa. Hallitset vastuualueesi, toimit ratkaisukeskeisesti ja olet motivoitunut kehittämään osaamistasi hoitotyön ammattilaisena. Työtehtävässä edellytetään, että ymmärtää toimintaan vaikuttavat lait ja säännökset sekä osaa soveltaa niitä käytännön työssä. Lisäksi tulee hallita omavalvonnan periaatteet, jotta palvelun laatu ja asiakasturvallisuus varmistuvat. Työ edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Eduksi luemme voimassa olevan LOVelääkeluvan, kokemuksen muistisairaiden hoidosta ja toimintakykyä tukevasta työskentelystä sekä OMNI360 ja RAIosaamisen ja hyvät tietotekniset taidot.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto sekä voimassa oleva rekisteröinti JulkiTerhikki- ja JulkiSuosikki-rekisterissä.

Hae mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä ikääntyneiden parissa Villa Piipariin - odotamme hakemustasi. Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Sijoitus on aluksi vammaispalvelujen varahenkilöstössä, mutta myös muut alueet voivat tulla kyseeseen. Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!

Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun valtioneuvoston asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä.

jobs.title: Technical Storekeeper
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Technical Storekeeper is responsible for handling and managing the receiving, storage, and processing of incoming and outgoing spare parts and technical supplies at one or more Carnival Corporation owned and operated global destination. This role supports the overall management of inventory levels, ensuring that all materials are accurately accounted for, properly stored, and readily available for technical teams as needed. The Technical Storekeeper monitors stock levels, maintains accurate records, coordinates with procurement for replenishment, and ensures compliance with company policies and safety standards. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with maintenance and technical staff to support smooth operational workflows.

  • Inventory Management and Record Keeping
  • Keep accurate records regarding stock counts, requirements, and reporting needs.
  • Review and issue a weekly inventory list of technical spares.
  • Update and maintain system records upon arrival of new parts and tools.
  • Label and maintain all tools, equipment, and spare parts.
  • Audit incoming materials for accurate paperwork and counts.
  • Confirm deliveries against invoices for accuracy of store count.
  • Monitor inventory levels to prevent shortages or overstock situations.
  • Track usage of spare parts to support maintenance planning and budgeting.
  • Ordering and Procurement Support
  • Place requests for all parts necessary for the storeroom for review and approval.
  • Assist with purchasing items and materials as needed.
  • Liaise with staff, management, and vendors to source supplies efficiently.
  • Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely delivery of parts.
  • Review vendor quotes and maintain records of supplier transactions.
  • Suggest alternatives for unavailable or discontinued parts.
  • Stores Organization and Receiving
  • Maintain stores in an organized and well-ordered manner.
  • Assist with unloading containers, sorting, counting, and receiving materials.
  • Ensure proper storage, handling, and labeling of all parts and tools.
  • Implement storage systems to maximize space and accessibility.
  • Conduct regular inspections to ensure cleanliness and orderliness of storerooms.
  • Follow safety protocols when handling heavy or hazardous materials.
  • Reporting, Compliance, and Other Duties
  • Create required reports related to inventory, usage, and discrepancies.
  • Uphold environmental policies and procedures in all store operations.
  • Document and report any damaged or defective parts to management.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by management.
  • Support cross-functional teams by providing required spare parts and technical materials.
  • Assist in audits and inspections as needed.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Needed

  • Ability to adhere to the companyâs standards regarding dress and appearance.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and data protection standards when handling vendor financial or business documents
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment as necessary.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to multitask effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with data entry and reporting tools.
  • Detail orientated with a proactive approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to multi-task and think critically
  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Strong planning and coordination skills, especially in handling multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Must be physically fit.
  • Ability to work in an outdoor environment as needed.
  • May need to stand for long periods of time.
  • May be requested to work a shift schedule while at any of the destinations.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of workplace policies and procedures / Familiarity with team collaboration tools and techniques.
  • Skills: Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Abilities: Ability to maintain reliable and consistent attendance / Capacity to be punctual and meet deadlines / Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and work as part of a team / Demonstrated professionalism in all interactions and tasks.

HESS Responsibilities

  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and guidelines related to health, safety, environmental protection, and security.
  • Take all necessary precautions, use personal protective equipment (PPE), safety devices, and tools correctly and consistently, as required by the nature of the work.
  • Promptly report any unsafe conditions, incidents, or environmental concerns to the appropriate supervisor or HESS representative.
  • Take reasonable care for your own health and safety, as well as that of colleagues and others who may be affected by your actions.
  • Actively participate in HESS trainings and initiatives that promote a safe, secure, and environmentally sustainable workplace.
  • Cooperate fully with company efforts to maintain compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Seek opportunities to improve safety and environmental performance in daily tasks.

Essential/Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED ; equivalent experience is required; additional education in Hospitality or a related field is a plus
  • Current Health Certificate

Essential Experience Required

  • A minimum of two (2) years relevant work experience in a technical role
  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds.
  • Ability to create reports and documentation skills.
  • Analytical and Numerate Skills
  • Strong interpersonal, problem solving, conflict resolution and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Working knowledge of: Swimming hazards; Beach Hazards; Pool hazards Lifeguard training techniques
  • First aid and Cardio-pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • All island employees must be physically able to participate in emergency lifesaving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency.

Przygotowywaniem i estetycznym wykładaniem bufetu śniadaniowego.
Procesem produkcyjnym na kuchni (np. krojenie warzyw, pieczywa, przygotowywanie prostych dań ciepłych i zimnych przekąsek).

Ddbaniu o czystość i porządek w strefie bufetowej oraz na sali restauracyjnej.

Sprzątaniu sali i zaplecza po zakończeniu serwisu śniadaniowego.

Jeśli odpowiedź brzmi TAK  ta oferta jest dla Ciebie!

Stabilne warunki zatrudnienia (umowa zlecenie).
Elastyczny grafiik  praca na cały etat.
Terminowe i atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie.
Pyszne śniadania i dobrą kawę w pracy.
Przyjazną atmosferę w zgranym zespole.
Szkolenie wprowadzające  nie martw się, wszystkiego Cię nauczymy!

Wyślij swoje CV na adres: kielce-management@hotelbb.com z tytułem Asystent Śniadaniowy lub zadzwoń pod numer 885886126.

Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy?
Aktualnej książeczki zdrowia do celów sanitarno-epidemiologicznych (lub gotowości do jej wyrobienia).
Chęci do pracy w godzinach porannych (praca zazwyczaj od 5)
Wysokiej kultury osobistej, uśmiechu i pozytywnego nastawienia.
Dbałości o higienę, estetykę oraz wysoki standard serwowanych posiłków.
Umiejętności pracy w zespole oraz dobrej organizacji własnego czasu.
Doświadczenie na podobnym stanowisku  będą dodatkowym atutem!

jobs.title: Solution Architect (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Main duties

Our Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in translating idea proposals into comprehensive solution design documents. This position involves close collaboration with the Enterprise Architecture team and lead developers to ensure all aspects of the solution are thoroughly documented and aligned with business needs.

    Develop detailed solution design documents based on initial idea proposals and business analysis.
    Create and maintain precise documentation, including data models, infrastructure designs, application maps, and cost impact analyses.
    Ensure all necessary documentation is drafted in collaboration with the Enterprise Architecture team and lead developers.
    Conduct data protection, risk, and security assessments to ensure compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
    Oversee the completeness of the solution design, initiating design authority meetings and securing final approval from relevant authorities.
    Participate in the continuous enhancement of the development process.
    Develop and standardise documentation and procedures related to software solution designs and integrations.
    Act as a technical liaison between project stakeholders, including business units, project leaders, and development teams, providing expert advice and guidance on the implementation and operation of IT solutions.
    Provide technical leadership and support to team members, offering insights and solutions to improve project outcomes.

    

Your blueprint for success at Luxair
Essential qualifications:

    A bachelor's degree in Information Technology or an equally compelling story of experience and expertise.
    Proven experience as a Solution Architect or in a similar role within IT architecture and design.
    Exceptional ability to document and articulate complex solutions clearly and effectively.
    Demonstrated ability in leading assessment processes and ensuring compliance with all regulatory and internal guidelines.
    Strong collaborative skills and the ability to work effectively across different teams and disciplines.
    A commitment to continuous learning and a willingness to dive deep into new technologies and tools.
    Excellent level spoken and written communication in English ensuring flawless information dissemination.



Desired or to be acquired required attributes:

    Strong understanding of Oracle databases and the ability to apply this knowledge to solution designs.
    Proficient in various aspects of IT architecture, including integration, data migration, and database management (both Relational and NoSQL), as well as data modelling and application design.
    Demonstrates comprehensive expertise across all phases of the software development life cycle, encompassing analysis, design, data migration, and integration.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant GRIC (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Consultant GRIC

Locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100099

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Your future team

Our multidisciplinary GRIC team of professionals is advising clients in various industries of the Financial Sector on how best to meet the regulatory, corporate governance and compliance challenges. We are assisting key function holders (comprising managing / governing bodies, executive management and head of internal control functions) to better understand the regulatory environment and its development and to identify laws and regulations having an impact on their business.
Forvis Mazars Financial Advisory Services is looking for outstanding individuals who will join a dynamic team committed to be the emerging Consulting & Advisory firm in Luxembourg.

Your role

• Provide advisory services to a broad range of financial institutions in Luxembourg (e.g. investment fund managers, electronic payment institutions, banks, investment firms, and other professionals of the financial sector), focusing on operational best practices and regulatory requirements.
• Advise clients on key regulatory matters (e.g. MiFID, ESG, Governance, Risk Management, Compliance, Portfolio Management, AML/CTF) by leading regulatory PMO projects, driving remediation initiatives, and managing deliverables such as gap and benchmark analyses, regulatory due diligences, and application files to Luxembourg authorities.
• Partner with clients throughout the full assignment cycle, from scoping and planning to implementation and post-delivery support, ensuring lasting value creation.
• Oversee and actively manage day-to-day tasks of assigned engagements, ensuring quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction.
• Guide, mentor, and support junior team members, fostering professional development, knowledge-sharing, and effective teamwork.
• Develop and deliver client-facing materials (e.g. presentations, flyers, tenders) on European and Luxembourg regulatory matters to strengthen our service offering and market presence.
• Collaborate with clients' management and the GRIC team to proactively identify new market opportunities, contribute to service innovation, and support business development initiatives.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of professional experience in the financial sector, with proven expertise in governance, risk management, compliance, or regulatory advisory.
• Good understanding of Luxembourg and EU regulatory frameworks (e.g. MiFID, ESG, Governance, Risk Management, Compliance, AML/CTF).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented solutions.
• Excellent report writing, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate confidently and effectively with senior stakeholders.
• Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including experience in managing projects, guiding junior colleagues, and coordinating cross-functional teams.
• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within challenging deadlines.
• Fluency in English and French is required; German is considered an asset.

We offer

• The opportunity to deepen your skills in regulatory (e.g. laws, regulations, circulars) and to participate in regulatory implementation projects (e.g. MiFID, ESG, internal governance, compliance, risk management, portfolio management, AML/CTF);
• The chance to develop your business approach / eminence, interpersonal skills and knowledge of the financial market place;
• A dynamic, multicultural, and collaborative work environment with competitive remuneration and benefits.
• A strong focus on personal development and professional growth, including support in obtaining relevant certifications (e.g. ILA, PRM, FRM, CIA, or other governance and risk-related qualifications).
• The advantages of working in a human-sized international firm that combines professional excellence with a commitment to societal impact as well as global reach with a personal and collaborative working culture.
• A young, energetic, and supportive team culture where your contribution is valued, and where you can make a tangible difference for both clients and the firm.
• The opportunity to contribute to international projects or work with cross-border teams, while your base will be in Luxembourg.
Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

jobs.title: Senior Fund Administrator - Level 1 (m/f)
jobs.description:
Your role

Our Administration team at Saltgate provide a bespoke suite of administration services. Our experienced team members deliver high
quality output designed to support throughout the fund life cycle.

Reporting to the Assistant Manager or Manager you will be the senior point of contact on all administration matters for a portfolio of clients
ensuring all items are completed and delivered within strict operational deadlines across client entity transactions. You will also act as a mentor
and supervisor for Juniors and Fund Administrators.

Your focus

- Coordinate, organise and document Board meeting and shareholder meeting including drafting minutes, preparing resolutions and ensuring action follow-up.
- Monitor and track incoming emails and ensure they are responded to on a timely basis, escalating where appropriate.
- Manage the full lifecycle of Luxembourg entities: incorporation, liquidation, restructuring, repatriation, statutory filings, audit coordination.
- Maintenance of accurate corporate records and database.
- Support deal execution by assisting with KYC/AML reviews, transaction documents and understanding investment structures.
- Lifecycle of investor transactions: capital call, distribution, transfer, capital call and distribution notices, capital Statements, investor register's update.
- Lead the communications with client contacts, lawyers, auditors, investors, bankers and other third parties.

Your experience

- Prior experience of 3 years in company administration in Luxembourg, ideally within financial services and investment funds framework along with knowledge of AIF structures
- Able to demonstrate excellent communication skills providing clear direction around delivery and able to delegate effectively
- Demonstrate a collaborate style working with others to build partnerships to meet shared objectives
- Be able to analyse complex information to effectively solve problems
- Has good judgement and decision-making skills and is able to deliver optimal client solutions

All individuals are assigned responsibility for assisting in the overall information security and data protection environment. This includes
attending and completing all mandatory information security and data protection training and complying with all applicable policies and
procedures.

Any questions or issues should be escalated in a timely manner to designated individuals, or if in doubt, consultation should take place with the relevant line manager.

Our pledge

As a people-first organisation, we aim to attract the best people and help them develop so they can deliver exceptional client services.

We embrace diversity, and have a culture of openness, which is reflected in our core values - engagement, partnership, integrity, and commitment. Whether you're a client or a colleague, Saltgate will partner with you to ensure you can achieve your best.

Saltgate is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of
sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:
Role purpose: At Vodafone, we work every day to build a better future, for a world that is more connected, inclusive and sustainable. Travel eSIM is Vodafone's proposition for the hundreds of millions of international travellers that are looking for an easy and affordable solution to stay connected with friends, family or business partners while abroad, beyond their roaming plan. Travel eSIM is a key growth pillar at the heart of our Commercial strategy at Vodafone Group. We are breaking new ground with innovative offers and technologies like eSIM and our goal is to become the operator of choice for travellers abroad

The Senior Marketing Manager leads the marketing team. They are seen as a leader on all commercial activities related to Travel eSIM, with solid commercial knowledge of the industry, channels/partners, competition challenges. The role takes overall responsibility for driving maximum growth of Vodafone's Travel eSIM business worldwide, including definition and execution of pricing, proposition, market communication strategy & top-class customer experience.

The successful candidate will be a true influencer in the organisation and will help Vodafone scale its Travel eSIM business globally delivering superior customer experience and revenue growth, in line with Vodafone's commercial strategy.

Accountabilities and decision ownership: 

Own, lead and co-create proposition and pricing strategy for Travel eSIM offers including regional/local, segmented, time-bound promotions  

Develop and own integrated marketing plan and budgets  

Prepare briefs and provide input into proposition materials, comms materials, guides, FAQs  

Define & collect customer insights  

Define, propose and approve customer journeys  

Management of Brand activities

Management of Wholesale activities



Essential competencies, knowledge and experience: 

Strong knowledge of the telecoms industry and extensive pricing and commercial experience  

Excellent understanding of evolving customer attitudes in travel industry, behavioural economics, telecoms services and value perceptions  

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of data-driven approaches  

Ability to rapidly understand and respond to strategic implications of external market developments.  

Very strong analytical, communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills  

Excellent strategic thinking and ability to lead change and execute strategy  

Ability to prioritise and demonstrating resilience  


Études:
Niveau d'étude demandé egal Bachelor (Bac +3)

jobs.title: COZINHEIRO
jobs.description:
Pretende se recrutar um a Cozinheiro para integrar um novo projeto de restauração privilegiando candidatos com forte motivação sentido de responsabilidade e vontade de crescer profissionalmente.

Será responsável pela preparação confeção e empratamento dos produtos assegurando o cumprimento das fichas técnicas dos padrões de qualidade e das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar HACCP. Deverá colaborar na organização da cozinha preparação de ingredientes receção e armazenamento de mercadorias controlo de stocks limpeza do posto de trabalho e apoio às restantes tarefas da operação diária.

Procura se um profissional organizado dinâmico com capacidade para trabalhar em equipa gerir o tempo de forma eficiente e manter um bom desempenho em períodos de maior exigência. Valoriza se uma atitude proativa atenção ao detalhe capacidade de aprendizagem e compromisso com a melhoria contínua.

É valorizada formação na área da cozinha e restauração e ou experiência profissional em funções semelhantes. No entanto serão igualmente considerados candidatos com potencial de desenvolvimento desde que demonstrem interesse pela profissão vontade de aprender e capacidade de integração numa equipa orientada para a qualidade e excelência no serviço.

O profissional terá a oportunidade de integrar um projeto inovador em fase de crescimento beneficiando de acompanhamento contínuo formação em contexto de trabalho e possibilidade de evolução e integração futura na empresa de acordo com o desempenho demonstrado.

jobs.title: CHEFE DE COZINHA
jobs.description:

Será responsável pela preparação confeção e empratamento dos produtos garantindo elevados padrões de qualidade apresentação e consistência. jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.



This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.



This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in English and German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €260,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. during beta, yes â both tiers, no credit card, no trial clock. after beta: core is $10/machine/month for monitoring, control, deploy, displays, and cortex on a single site. pro is $50/machine/month (3-machine minimum) and adds the public API, CLI, SDK, webhooks, unlimited sites, and roost â incremental project sync with 1 TB included storage per site. no per-user fees on either.

no. owlette is windows-only. your mac is fine â it doesn't need monitoring. it'll let you know when something's wrong. loudly. in the middle of a show.

the agent keeps running. it monitors and auto-recovers processes whether or not it can reach the cloud. when the connection returns, it syncs everything it missed. your machines don't need the internet to run. they've been alone before. they know how to survive.

no inbound ports, no vpn. agents connect outbound over https (port 443) to google's firebase infrastructure. if your network allows general internet access, it just works. locked-down environments may need to whitelist *.googleapis.com and *.firebaseio.com.

cortex is owlette's ai fleet assistant â ask it the questions you ask yourself every day: "which nvidia driver are we running?", "restart the media server on node 3", "what crashed at 3am?" it translates natural language into real commands across your fleet. you bring your own api key (openai, anthropic, or any compatible provider).

roost is owlette's project sync. point it at a folder â a TouchDesigner project, a content drop, a build output â and it ships only the bytes that changed to every machine on the site, atomically: a machine gets the whole new version or stays on the old one, never a half-copied mess. every deploy is versioned, so you can roll back to any of the last 50 for up to 30 days. it's part of the pro tier and includes 1 TB of storage per site ($0.05/GB after that). no more zipping a folder and RDP-ing into ten machines at 2am.

agents connect over tls, credentials are encrypted on-device using a machine-bound key, and oauth tokens are never logged or stored in plaintext. access is managed through firebase auth with optional passkey and two-factor authentication.

yes â owlette is FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 (converts to apache 2.0 two years after each release). the full source is on github. fair warning: it requires firebase, a railway (or equivalent) deployment for the web app, and a willingness to blow past your usage limits at 3am debugging support tickets from your neighbor's camper because your furnace broke and it's -10 outside. we won't talk you out of it, but the hosted version exists for a reason.

jobs.title: Asiakaspalvelija / Ravintolatyöntekijä – Teboil Malmi (2 paikkaa)
jobs.description:
**Teboil Malmi** etsii reippaita ja asiakaspalveluhenkisiä työntekijöitä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tarjolla on kaksi työpaikkaa, ja etsimme ensisijaisesti kokoaikaisia työntekijöitä. Myös osa-aikaisista hakijoista olemme kiinnostuneita.

Työtehtävät

Työ on monipuolista asiakaspalvelu- ja ravintolatyötä, johon kuuluu muun muassa:

- asiakaspalvelu ja kassatyöskentely

- vitriinituotteiden valmistus ja esillepano

- Rolls-pikaruoka-annosten valmistaminen

- myymälän ja ravintolatilojen siisteydestä sekä puhtaudesta huolehtiminen

- tuotteiden täydennykset ja muut päivittäiset toimipaikan tehtävät

- Veikkaus-palveluiden asiakaspalvelu ja myynti


Työ on vaihtelevaa, joten arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, joustavuutta ja kykyä työskennellä myös kiireessä.

Odotamme sinulta

- vähintään 18 vuoden ikää

- iloista ja palveluhenkistä asennetta

- hyvää yhteistyökykyä sekä vastuullista työotetta

- valmiutta tehdä vuorotyötä


Aiempi työkokemus ravintola- tai kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä. Myös kokemus Veikkaus-palveluista katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä. Perehdytämme tehtävään.

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn mukavassa työyhteisössä

- monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät

- kattavan perehdytyksen

- työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen (Marava TES)

- mahdollisuuden työskennellä kokoaikaisesti tai sopimuksen mukaan osa-aikaisesti


**Työsuhde alkaa** noin kolmen päivän kuluessa työsopimuksen allekirjoittamisesta tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Tule mukaan palvelemaan asiakkaitamme ja osaksi Teboil Malmin tiimiä!

jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Nordics
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets

 - Fluency in Swedish or Norwegian
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €70,000 OTE per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Donât Put Yourself a Box
jobs.description:
Photo by Piotr MusioÅ / Unsplash

Donât Put Yourself in a Box

Personal Development and Career Growth

  • Apr 26, 2024

Summary

  • Companies need "boxes" (job classifications) to grow and function. This makes hiring, compensation, and career development tractable, and promotes fair treatment of employees.
  • If the boxes are too large, a company can't grow. If the boxes are too small, innovation and ownership are smothered.
  • The size of a company's boxes is directly proportional to the level of trust employees have for management.
  • To get hired, put yourself in the box the company is hiring for. Tailor your resume to highlight those skills and experiences; put yourself out there as a âspecialistâ in the thing theyâre hiring for.
  • If aiming for a promotion, demonstrate how your work embodies the behaviors and impacts of the next-level âboxâ.
  • Don't let those boxes define you. Your value and identity goes far beyond any job description.

Hot Take

Businesses can't function at scale unless they put people in standardized "boxes"; if you want to be hired and to grow your career, you need to understand that, and understand how to work with those boxes. On the other hand, you can't be reduced to a box, and if you tie your identity to those boxes in your thinking, you'll limit yourself in ways that are unnatural and harmful.

This is like the paradox of SchrÃ¶dinger's Cat, both alive and dead at the same time. Like with quantum mechanics and the cat, whether youâre in a box or not depends on whoâs doing the measuring: your employer, or you.

My Box Origin Story

My introduction to the idea of âboxesâ came in the late 2000s, when I noticed that people at Google were having a hard time getting hired or promoted if they were doing âoperationalâ work that didnât involve much traditional program management. Whether they were being considered for hiring or promotion, they were told, essentially, âYouâve done some great work, but itâs not program management; weâre not sure what role/ladder is a fit for you, but itâs not this one. Next!â

This was clearly a problemâeven though they didnât do PERT diagrams and Gantt charts, Googlers did important work in these roles, and roadblocks to hiring and promoting them created both operational and retention issues as jobs went vacant and high-performing employees felt their value wasnât being recognized. As a member of both Program Management hiring and promotion committees at Google I had more visibility to this issue than most others; I spoke to a friend of mine in People Operations (Googleâs HR), who turned out to already be well aware of this problem from repeatedly dealing with upset hiring managers and frustrated promotion candidates. Together, we hatched a plan: to create a new job ladder (job classification) for these âoperationalâ program managers to move to, that was better suited to the type of work they did.

We gathered some data, wrote a proposal, and set up a meeting with the SVP responsible for all engineering at Google. The SVP had been in quite a few meetings Iâd presented to before; I knew him to be not only a brilliant and capable leader, but a genuinely nice guy, too, so I had no worries about the meeting. Imagine my shock then, when this âgenuinely nice guyâ started yelling at us, telling my partner and I that we were going to wreck Google culture!

I vividly remember what he said: âDONâT PUT PEOPLE IN BOXES!â He told us Google needed some job classifications, but that our culture required those classifications to be both broad and vague so both employees and their managers wouldnât be blocked from doing whatever needed to be done. The worst thing we could do, the SVP told us, was to make the classification âboxesâ so small people could say âthatâs not my jobââwhich is precisely what he saw us proposing to do!

A year or two before this Google had shifted from having just three job types (over-broadly, they were âengineersâ, âtechnical people that donât do engineeringâ, and âeveryone elseâ) to having around around a dozen (one of which was my ladder, âTechnical Program Managersâ). There had been a lot of debate about whether those boxes were already too smallâ¦ but the senior team had decided 12â15 job categories were acceptableâenough large boxes to make hiring, career development, and compensation more efficient, but not so many that jobs were defined too narrowly. We left his office dejected, but also enlightened: it said a lot to me that this SVP thought it so important to Googleâs culture, a lesson Iâve never forgotten. (Times have changed though; Google now has many more job ladders, including at least 5â10 âoperationalâ ladders broken off from Program Management well beyond what my friend and I had proposed).

Why Companies Need Boxes

Why do we need âboxesâ (job classifications) at all? Wouldnât the world be better if everyone just did whatever they saw that needed doing? The value of boxes to corporations comes down to two things: scaling and trust.

Scaling

If youâre in a small startup, you want employees who can wear many hats, and who wonât feel limited by things like job titles. Because there are so few employees, and because you know everyone personally and need everyone you hire to have an outsized impact, you can afford to put a lot of energy into every individual hiring decision. Compensation planning is pretty lightweight and customized, both because there arenât many people to deal with, and because you want to compensate people based on their contribution to the business, regardless of what their title is. Everyone is a âspecial snowflakeâ.

That changes quickly as your startup growsâyou cross a line where it becomes infeasible to treat every hire as a unique individual, with bespoke hiring and compensation. This is where âboxesâ become necessary: you have to put people into categories, with standards for how hiring, compensation, and career progression work for each boxâitâs the only way you can scale the company. The alternative to this would be to allow an increasing number of managers to continue bespoke hiring and comp within their own areasâ¦ which leads to the second issue, trust.

Trust

Because startups are so risky, the ability of potential employees to trust the founders is a big dealâif they donât appear trustworthy, theyâre not going to attract the kind of people they need. As the company grows, the number of managers that both employees and senior management need to trust grows, too. At some point it becomes too much: employeesâ willingness to âhave faithâ that managers will make fair and appropriate decisions drops lower and lower, so much so that everything will fall apart without the enforced fairness of standardized boxes.

ð¡

The size of the boxes in a company are directly proportional to the amount of trust employees have in management

Labor unions are the endgame for this sort of trust problem. One of the big rallying points for companies trying to avoid unionization is always to try to convince employees that management has their best interests at heart, and can be trusted. As a rule, unions have close to zero trust for management, andâas a direct consequenceâunions often push for the smallest âboxesâ possible: boxes for very narrow roles, subdivided by seniority, and sometimes further subdivided by location. They see this as the best way to ensure fairness in an environment where management canât be trusted at all. This is the ultimate version of the cultural harm my SVP was worried about.

Boxes and Hiring

Scaling and trust drive companies to put employees into standard categories, or boxes. How do those boxes affect hiring, and, understanding this, how can you better âsellâ yourself as a candidate for jobs?

Most companies above startup size need to hire for boxes, for the reasons given above; itâs just too much work to do anything else. It would be wonderful if recruiters, interviewers, and hiring managers had the time to carefully read and savor every resume that came in, and then spend time meeting with every candidate to pull out nuances that didnât come across clearly in their job histories. Thatâs not the world we live in, though; there are too many candidates to get through, and too few hours in the day.

The usual practice is for recruiters to work with hiring managers to identify standard requirements (boxes, again!) that can be used to screen out people and reduce the number of candidates they need to go into more depth with (hiring managers will usually never see any of those dropped candidates). Those standard requirements are typically based on a template used for all jobs of the same ladder and level, extended with custom specs tailored to the particular role being hired for. In the language Iâve been using in this article, the job requirements are a very clear âboxâ, and the screening process only lets through candidates whose âshapesâ fit that box, like a childâs sorting toy.

Source: Flickr user rosipaw, CC BY-NC-SA 2.0

When there are lots of candidates for a tiny number of jobs, the recruiters donât magically get more time to handle the extra candidatesâinstead, they often deal with the overload by tightening the screening criteria even further: that is, by making the boxes smaller.

Behaviorally, the shift from âstartupâ to âbig companyâ, and the shift from rapid growth to slow growth, show up to candidates as employers become increasingly selective. Startups like generalists; big companies like specialists. If there are few people vying for each job, hiring managers won't care as much about past experience; if there are many candidates, theyâll only be interested in people whoâve previously done the same kind job theyâre hiring for. These trends are amplified when business is tough and hiring budgets are thin: hiring managers become nervous about using their scarce headcount on unproven candidatesâthey need people who have already shown success in exactly the job the manager needs done.

ð¡

Iâm writing this in April, 2024, in a time of high interest rates and widespread layoffs in tech, and when there are lots of AI-based screening tools being offered that promise to save recruiters time; you do the math about the current hiring marketâ¦

Besides being lucky, there are two powerful ways to cut through âsmall box screeningâ:

  • Put yourself in the box theyâre hiring for. This means customizing your resume for each job you apply for, or at least for each type of job youâre going after. If theyâre hiring for someone with experience doing X, focus your resume on how youâve been successful doing X (or at least, things like X) in the past. When a recruiter or hiring manager looks at your resume, you want them to jump out of their chair and exclaim: âwow, this person is exactly what weâve been looking for!â
  • Pull a Kobayashi Maru by bypassing the whole screening process: use your network of personal connections to get an introduction to the hiring manager. This is probably the single most powerful thing you can do because it exposes you to the hiring manager as a whole person, instead of a peg that fits in a box.

Boxes and Promotions

A similar situation arises with promotions: the people making decisions about whether you should be promoted or not donât (usually) have the familiarity with you, or the time, to make a customized decisionâ¦ and doing so would create fairness issues. Instead, they look at whether you fit the next-level box. I want to talk about two parts to this: one related to the job ladder, and one related to the level.

Job Ladder

I vividly remember one promotion committee I served on, where we were deciding whether or not to promote an individual who had unquestionably performed at the next levelâ¦ but the work theyâd done wasnât consistent with the job ladder (work classification) they were assigned to. They had delivered amazing business impact through striking personal initiative, leadership, and hard workâ¦ but what theyâd done had nothing in common with the sort of work expected for the job ladder, or âboxâ, they were in. Should we promote them, or not? We debated the question for far longer than weâd spent on any other candidate weâd reviewed, called in HR support to advise us, andâ¦ we couldnât decide. The rules were that âif you canât decide, the decision needs to be ânoââ, so we ended by turning down the promotion and recommending the person for a large cash bonus, instead. Our decision was appealed, and the appeal was denied, too, for the same reason: despite the great work, the candidateâs work was outside the box.

Sometimes the process and people deciding on your promotions will be more amenable to âoutside the boxâ work, but really, regardless of whoâs making the promotion decision, and what their ârules of engagementâ are, your chances of success will be greatly enhanced by you being aware of the box imposed by your job ladder as you go about your work, and as you explain that work to others. To be clear: Iâm not saying to limit what you work onâthatâs the ânot my jobâ problem the SVP at the beginning of the article was talking about! What I am saying is that you should proactively plan how you will describe your work in ways consistent with the box.

For example, if youâre a Program Manager and spent a lot of time creating product requirements (the work of a Product Manager at most companies), when you and your direct manager describe it to others, be sure you both talk about (for example) the work you did to understand what other work was dependent on having the requirements, how you delegated and tracked some of the work on market research, bringing it all together into a single document, how you built consensus on the requirements, communicated them to the engineering team, and then managed scope creepâall things that are part of the description of the Program Management box. This makes it easy for the people who will decide on your promotion to say âHuzzah! They did both the Program and Product Managementâ, instead of saying âThis was great Product Management, too bad theyâre a Program Manager.â

Job Level

Really, this is a topic that deserves (and will get) an article all on its own, but I think itâs relevant to surface it here: in general, higher level jobs arenât just harder/bigger/broader versions of lower level jobs: theyâre different âboxesâ altogether. The next-level behaviors senior people are looking for are often behaviors that arenât exercised much, if at all, at your current level. I think of these as âphase changesâ, analogous to the phase changes water goes through as it turns from solid ice to liquid to gas as you turn up the heat: itâs always the same water, but it looks and behaves differently in each phase. Some of these transitions are more abrupt and noticeable than others, but theyâre definitely there. At Google for example, there are noticeable differences between all levels, but the âphase changesâ are especially acute between levels 5 and 6, and between levels 7 and 8.

The takeaway here is that you can greatly increases your chances of success by understanding what those âphase changesâ are (more senior mentors can be super helpful in this)âwhatâs qualitatively different about the next-level boxâand then work with your manager to proactively plan how you will describe your work in ways that highlight those qualitative differences.

Boxes and You

So after telling you about the importance of âboxesâ, now Iâm going to tell youâ¦ to avoid them!

This sure looks like a paradox, but let me explain!

Weâve been talking about how companies, managers, and recruiters use boxes, and how, because of scaling and trust, itâs just not practical for them to operate in any other way. Weâd hope that they donât make the boxes too small, and that they have good judgment in how they apply themâ¦ but boxes are a fact of life in the world of work.

The place where you should avoid boxes isnât in the workplace, though: it's in your head. Itâs completely natural for peopleâs occupation and organization to become a part of their identityâ¦ but it's harmful to let that go too far: you are not your job, and you are not your job title.

A lot has been written about the psychology of tying oneâs identity to their job, but the thing I want to focus on here is how putting yourself in a box in your own thinking (e.g. seeing yourself as a âProduct Managerâ, as a âGooglerâ, and so on) can mean putting counterproductive limits on your own behavior, and your own thinking about whatâs possible.

ð¡

Youâre much more than, and much more capable than, the box youâre in.

From a career perspective, itâs a good practice to periodically take some time out and take stock of where you are now and how that fits with where you want to go. If you do this sort of self-assessment youâll often decide youâre basically on the right path and just need to make some minor adjustmentsâ¦ but sometimes youâll realize that the path youâre on wonât take you where you want to be, and that bigger changes are needed: maybe you should ask your manager for different responsibilities? Change teams? Change job ladders? Even change companies? All of those require seeing beyond the box youâre in.

Even though you need to describe yourself in terms of boxes to get where you are now, if your own thinking is constrained by those boxes, it will be hard for you to see that maybe the best path for you is quite different from the one youâre on. Maybe you should change teams? Roles? Departments? Even change your city, or your employer? Donât get me wrong: I know plenty of people whoâve been in more or less the same job, in the same place, working for the same company, for many years, and theyâre very happyâ¦ but itâs also common for people stay in the same role because they see that role defining them, instead of just being something they do.

How You Can Bring Order From Chaos, Today

Here are some things you can do now to apply these ideas:

  • If youâre looking for a job now, describe yourself as being well inside the box your potential employer is hiring for: tune your resume to the job youâre going after. You should have a different resume at least for every âclassâ of job, and sometimes for each specific job. It can be hard to do it if youâre going after several types of job at the same time, but your LinkedIn resume needs to support the more focused, specialized resumes youâre using. Make sure you highlight the skills and expertise called out in the job ads youâre applying to, and talk about your skill and experience in that area. No one hires generalists, so donât call yourself one in your resume; instead, describe yourself as a specialist in the very thing your target company is hiring for.
  • If youâre working toward a promotion now, put yourself in the box you want to be promoted to. Ask your manager and mentors to help you understand the heart of the next-level box, and think about how you can describe your work, behavior, and accomplishments in terms of that box.
  • Donât tie your identity to the box youâre in. You are a complete person with a personality, skills, and experience that transcend any mere box, and if you tie up your identity with the boxes other people put you in, you will limit the paths you can take and the things you can accomplish.

What Do You Think?

I'd love to hear about your experiences with boxes! If you're a paid supporter of this newsletter (hint, hint!) you can add comments below.

Youth Work Ireland is seeking a passionate and motivated Our Generation Youth Worker to join the Our Generation Project in County Louth. This full-time hybrid role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the mental health, wellbeing, and personal development of young people through innovative youth work programmes. As an Our Generation Youth Worker, you will recruit and engage young people, build strong relationships with schools, youth clubs, and community organisations, and deliver structured programmes including Mind Matters, CHOICE, Stand UPP, and Rise Up. These programmes focus on emotional resilience, leadership, healthy relationships, wellbeing, and peace-building across communities. In this role, you will deliver evidence based youth programmes that promote mental health, emotional resilience, leadership, and wellbeing for young people. You will work across schools, youth clubs, and community organisations throughout County Louth, building strong partnerships and creating engaging opportunities that empower young people and support positive outcomes. You will also collaborate with colleagues and partner organisations to deliver high-quality programmes that strengthen communities and encourage cross-community and cross-border engagement. Key Requirements * Level 7 qualification (or higher) in Youth & Community Work, Social Work, Social Care, or a related Social Science discipline. * Experience delivering structured programmes or workshops with young people. * Excellent communication, organisational, and teamwork skills. * Ability to engage young people in a variety of educational and community settings. * Full, clean driving licence and access to a car (essential). * Willingness to travel regularly throughout County Louth. This is a 35-hour per week hybrid position, a fixed-term contract from September 2026 to September 2027, with a starting salary of €41,500.49. If you are committed to empowering young people and creating positive change in your community, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Procurement Specialist to join our team in New York, New York in a contract capacity with the potential for a permanent role. This position will play an important role in supporting day-to-day purchasing operations, maintaining strong vendor documentation, and helping ensure procurement activities run smoothly across the business. The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers, finance partners, and internal stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

Responsibilities:
â¢ Manage the full processing cycle for purchase requests and purchase orders, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely execution.
â¢ Gather and evaluate vendor quotations for routine buying needs, helping identify competitive pricing and suitable supplier options.
â¢ Assist with supplier setup by collecting and organizing required forms, compliance records, insurance documents, and payment information.
â¢ Maintain current procurement records, including vendor profiles, contract files, and supporting purchasing documentation.
â¢ Monitor open orders, shipment timelines, and invoice-related issues, following up to resolve discrepancies efficiently.
â¢ Partner with Accounts Payable, Finance, and internal teams to address mismatches involving purchase orders, receipts, and invoices.
â¢ Track supplier agreement milestones and renewal timelines while helping maintain an organized contract and vendor calendar.
â¢ Prepare spend reports and purchasing analysis by supplier, category, and department to support business decision-making.
â¢ Help enforce procurement procedures by confirming purchases follow established approval steps and company policy requirements.
â¢ Contribute to sourcing activities by supporting bid reviews, supplier comparisons, reporting needs, audit documentation, and process improvement efforts within procurement systems and records management.
â¢ Bachelorâs degree in business, supply chain, accounting, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
â¢ 1â3 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, accounts payable, vendor administration, or a related function.
â¢ Working knowledge of corporate procurement practices, purchase order processing, and buying workflows.
â¢ Exposure to vendor support activities, contract-related administration, or contract negotiation coordination is preferred.
â¢ Strong Excel skills and experience using purchasing platforms or enterprise procurement systems.
â¢ Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage documentation, deadlines, and multiple priorities effectively.
â¢ Clear communication and sound problem-solving skills for working with suppliers and cross-functional internal teams.
â¢ Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment that requires adaptability and strong follow-through.
